title: Senior Software Engineer, SAP Finance AR/AP/Banking
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
At BMS, digital innovation and Information Technology are central to our vision of transforming patients’ lives through science. To accelerate our ability to serve patients around the world, we must unleash the power of technology. We are committed to being at the forefront of transforming the way medicine is made and delivered by harnessing the power of computer and data science, artificial intelligence, and other technologies to promote scientific discovery, faster decision making, and enhanced patient care.
  
  
Manager II, Senior Software Engineer, SAP Finance at Bristol Myers Squibb, digital innovation and IT are central to transforming patients’ lives through science. The organisation leverages AI, data science, and automation to enhance global finance operations.
  
  
The SAP Finance position plays a key role in delivering end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions, in areas of GL/AA/AP/AR/Bank, including integration with other areas such as Order to Cash, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and should have good understanding of working in a SOX and GxP environment. Responsibilities include designing, implementing, and optimizing scalable of SAP Finance solutions.
  
  
Collaboration with Business, IT, and external stakeholders is critical for standardisation and compliance.AI-enabled capabilities such as invoice automation, predictive analytics, and anomaly detection are leveraged. Gen-AI tools are used for documentation, testing, and improving operational efficiency.
  
  
The role supports full SDLC activities from requirements through post-go-live support. Continuous improvement, innovation, and adoption of emerging technologies are key expectations.
  
  
Experience delivering full lifecycle projects for 8-11 years in S/4 HANA in the areas of Finance including integration with other areas such as Materials Management, Manufacturing, Sales & Distribution, & Costing. Had experience working in a Global Environment who understands Global Process, Template Roll-out, SAP instances, Stakeholder Management, Cross-Functional.
  
  
If you want an exciting and rewarding career that is meaningful, consider joining our diverse team!
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**🚀 Shape the Future of Finance Technology | SAP S/4HANA Finance Specialist**
**Are you ready to make an impact where Finance meets innovation?**
We're looking for a talented
**SAP Finance GL/AA/AR/AP/Bank Accounting Specialist**
to join our global team and help drive the next generation of intelligent, cloud-enabled Finance solutions. If you're passionate about SAP, energised by transformation, and thrive in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment — we want to hear from you.
  
  
**Why This Role?**
This isn't just another SAP role. You'll be at the heart of a
**global finance transformation**
, working with cutting-edge SAP S/4HANA technology, AI-driven automation, and cloud innovation as part of our SAP RISE journey. You'll collaborate with talented teams across IT and business, solve complex challenges, and leave a lasting mark on how we operate at scale.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
**💡 Delivering Smart Finance Solutions**
Design and implement world-class SAP S/4 HANA solutions across General Ledger Accounting, Asset Accounting, Accounts Receivables, Accounts Payables and Banking including the DME Engine & Operational Accounting Processes.
  
  
Own full end-to-end SDLC delivery — from design and build through testing, deployment, and ongoing support
  
  
Identify process improvements and automation opportunities to improve costing accuracy, close efficiency, reporting transparency, and operational controls.
  
  
Strong hands-on experience in SAP FI sub-modules, including
**General Ledger Accounting, Asset Accounting, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Banking**
Extensive experience in executing and supporting
**Finance Period-End activities**
, including planning, monitoring, and issue resolution.
  
  
**💳 Powering Invoice-to-Pay & Cash Management**
Manage the complete invoice lifecycle — processing, validation, payment execution, and vendor reconciliation
  
  
Oversee AR processes including billing integration, cash application, dispute resolution, and reconciliations
  
  
**🏦 Banking & Treasury**
Lead efficient payment processing and bank integrations, ensuring compliance with treasury and financial regulations
  
  
**🔗 Connecting the Dots**
Drive seamless integration across
**O2C, P2P, Supply Chain**
, and external systems
  
  
Bridge SAP Finance with MM, SD, PP and CO to enable truly end-to-end business processes
  
  
**☁️ Driving Cloud & AI Transformation**
Leverage
**AI and intelligent automation**
to enhance SAP Finance processes by improving month end closure time using automation and/or process improvements for period-end close decisions.
  
  
Use
**GenAI tools**
to accelerate documentation, test automation, and root cause analysis
  
  
**🛡️ Keeping Us Compliant**
Ensure strong financial controls and audit readiness in line with
**SOX and GxP**
requirements
  
  
**🤝 Collaborating & Innovating**
Partner with global business and IT stakeholders to drive process optimisation and continuous improvement
  
  
Build strong relationships across teams, lead with curiosity, and champion a culture of learning and innovation
  
  
**What You'll Bring**
✅
**Bachelor's degree**
in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, or a related field
*(Master's a plus)*
✅
**8–11 years**
of SAP S/4HANA experience with at least
**2–3 full-cycle Finance implementations**
✅ Deep expertise in SAP’s SAP S4 HANA Finance functionality
  
  
✅ Cross-module integration experience across
**MM, SD, PP and CO**
✅ Basic
**ABAP debugging**
skills and technical integrations
  
  
✅ Proven experience in
**SOX and/or GxP regulated environments**
✅ A collaborative, global mindset with strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  
  
✅ A passion for
**continuous learning**
, AI adoption, and process innovation
  
  
**Bonus Points If You Have...**
⭐ Experience with
**SAP RISE / cloud migration**
initiatives
  
  
⭐ Exposure to
**AI, intelligent automation, or GenAI**
in a delivery context
  
  
⭐ Background in the
**pharmaceutical industry**

**BW or SAP Consolidation**
solutions (Group Reporting)

title: Oracle Fusion Finance consultant
description:
Seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Finance Professional with 10+ years of overall experience to lead, implement, support, and optimize financial processes and modules within Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials.
  
  
**Job Description**
Lead the functional management of Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials, including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management (CM), Expenses, and related Treasury/Banking integrations.
  
  
Gather and analyze business requirements, conduct fit-gap analysis, and translate business needs into functional specifications and Oracle Fusion solutions.
  
  
Design and document functional solutions, extensions, integrations, and reporting requirements where standard Oracle Fusion functionality does not fully meet business needs.
  
  
Collaborate closely with technical, integration, reporting, and business teams to communicate requirements and validate delivered solutions.
  
  
Provide functional expertise in Oracle Fusion Finance configuration, integrations, extensions, workflows, and reporting to improve financial processes.
  
  
Support enterprise structures, ledgers, legal entities, business units, accounting configurations, approval workflows, and financial controls.
  
  
Work with Oracle Fusion reporting capabilities such as OTBI, BI Publisher, and Financial Reporting based on project requirements.
  
  
Ensure adherence to financial controls, compliance requirements, audit readiness, and organizational governance within Oracle Fusion environments.
  
  
Create and maintain functional design documents, configuration documents, process flows, training materials, test scripts, and knowledge-base content for business users and support teams.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  
Lead the end-to-end Oracle Fusion Finance implementation and application lifecycle, including requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Act as the primary liaison between Finance, IT, Oracle/implementation partners, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless Fusion Financials operations.
  
  
Conduct impact assessments and risk analysis for configuration changes, enhancements, integrations, quarterly updates, and business-process changes.
  
  
Provide ongoing application support, including incident resolution, root-cause analysis, problem management, and continuous process improvements.
  
  
Analyze and troubleshoot functional and transactional issues and collaborate with technical teams for integration, data, reporting, and extension-related debugging.
  
  
Support data migration, conversions, interfaces, and integrations with upstream and downstream systems.
  
  
Work with third-party platforms and financial institutions to support integration points such as bank integrations, payment systems, reconciliation processes, and treasury solutions.
  
  
Support interfaces using applicable Oracle Fusion integration mechanisms such as REST/SOAP services, FBDI, ADFdi, and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) where relevant.
  
  
Participate in financial audits, compliance assessments, and internal-control reviews relating to Oracle Fusion Finance.
  
  
Plan and support SIT, UAT, regression testing, cutover, go-live, and post-production support to ensure high-quality deliverables.
  
  
Assess Oracle Fusion Cloud updates and coordinate regression testing and business validation for relevant Finance functionality.
  
  
Mentor junior functional consultants and team members, providing guidance and sharing Oracle Fusion Finance best practices.
  
  
Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for process standardization, automation, reporting improvements, and effective utilization of Oracle Fusion capabilities.

title: USI-EH27-Consulting-FT-GBS-Finance Operations Transformation-Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Finance Transformation (FT) - Finance Operations Transformation**
Join our Finance Transformation practice to help Deloitte client service teams define and execute Finance and Global Business Services agendas and strategies. You will work with world-class teams and insights, helping support delivery in challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to help unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we collaborate with teams to enable transforming finance.
  
  
**Finance Operations Transformation Senior Consultant**
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will help clients reimagine and optimize their finance processes to enable transformation, business growth and digital finance capabilities. This role involves designing future-state operating models, advising on ERP and technology solutions, and leading process improvements across core finance areas. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation on the Finance Transformation - Finance Operations Transformation team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Assessing, designing, and optimizing end-to-end finance processes across Procure to Pay, Order to Cash, Record to Report, and Financial Planning and Analysis
* Advising on ERP and digital finance solutions by aligning business requirements with standard and custom technology capabilities
* Redesigning finance processes, data structures, and performance measures, including chart of accounts, cost centers, profit centers, and key performance indicators
* Leading business requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, solution blueprinting, and future-state process design
* Collaborating with cross-functional and global stakeholders to deliver finance transformation programs on time and with measurable business impact

**The team**
Our Finance Transformation – Global Business Services (GBS) practice serves as a trusted advisor to CFOs and executives, helping shape the CFO agenda, improve operating models, and drive enterprise value in the digital economy. The GBS Advisory team partners with organizations to design and implement GBS strategies, including service delivery models, operating model transformation, and location strategies. Leveraging next-generation technologies like Generative AI, we drive innovation across Finance, Procurement, and IT. Our scope includes outsourcing advisory, vendor selection, and end-to-end transformation. We seek motivated individuals with strong analytical, communication, and consulting skills to join our dynamic GBS group
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Pune (Candidates from other locations should be willing to relocate)
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree and Master of Business Administration, or Chartered Accountant qualification
* 3-6 years of finance transformation experience; for Chartered Accountant candidates, 3-6 years of experience after qualification
* Experience in finance process assessment, process reengineering, business requirements gathering, and solution design
* Experience with one or more finance process areas, including Procure to Pay, Order to Cash, Record to Report, Financial Planning and Analysis, Tax, Treasury, or Risk and Compliance
* Experience advising on finance data and control structures, including chart of accounts, general ledger, accounting, controlling, costing, planning, consolidation, reporting, data management, or finance analytics
* Experience with ERP or finance technology platforms and alignment of business requirements to system functionality
* Experience creating design documentation, conducting gap analysis, and supporting transformation value realization

**Preferred:**

* Experience supporting or managing large-scale technology implementation programs
* Experience with one or more platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, Microsoft Dynamics, BlackLine, HighRadius, Basware, ServiceNow for Finance, Workiva, or Anaplan
* Experience with process mining or process mapping tools such as Celonis or Epiplex
* Experience in Finance Operations, Financial Planning and Analysis, Enterprise Performance Management, or industry-specific finance processes
* Experience with digital finance technologies such as robotic process automation, Generative AI, predictive analytics, or machine learning
* Experience working with global stakeholders or teams outside India, preferably in the United States

title: Associate Director - Finance
description:
About R1 RCM R1 is the leading provider of technology-driven solutions that transform the patient experience and financial performance of hospitals, health systems and medical groups. We are the one company that combines the deep expertise of a global workforce of revenue cycle professionals with the industry’s most advanced technology platform, encompassing sophisticated analytics, AI, intelligent automation and workflow orchestration. With over 30,000 employees globally and a robust presence in India, comprising over 17,000 employees across Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Bangalore, and Chennai, we foster an inclusive culture where every team member feels valued and empowered. Our mission is to transform the healthcare industry by driving efficiency for healthcare systems, hospitals, and physicians.
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
The Associate Director / Program Leader will lead FP&A and business finance support for assigned G&A functions and business segments. The role owns budgeting, forecasting, monthly performance management, consolidation of financial results, cost optimization governance, and decision support. The incumbent will serve as the primary finance contact for US stakeholders, translate complex results into clear business narratives, and accelerate finance transformation through automation, dashboards, and process simplification.
  
  
Role mandate: Create one integrated view of performance, enable fact-based decisions, and strengthen financial accountability across supported functions and business segments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategic Finance Business Partnering
  
  

* Serve as the trusted finance advisor to assigned G&A, functional, and business leaders.
* Act as the primary finance point of contact for US stakeholders, ensuring timely, accurate, and decision-useful support.
* Partner with leaders on resource allocation, investment choices, productivity opportunities, and financial trade-offs.
* Build effective relationships across Finance, Operations, HR, Technology, Real Estate, Procurement, Legal, and other corporate functions.

Budgeting, Forecasting and Planning
  
  

* Lead the annual operating plan, periodic forecasts, and long-range planning for assigned areas.
* Build driver-based forecasts across headcount, compensation, vendors, projects, technology, facilities, and other operating costs.
* Improve forecast accuracy through clear assumptions, disciplined stakeholder reviews, and timely refresh of risks and opportunities.
* Provide forward-looking scenarios and mitigation actions to support delivery against financial commitments.

Financial Consolidation and Enterprise Performance Management
  
  

* Lead consolidation of financial performance across business segments, functions, geographies, and service lines.
* Establish a consistent and reliable view of consolidated revenue, margin, headcount, productivity, and operating expense performance.
* Drive common definitions, KPIs, planning assumptions, and reporting standards across contributing finance teams.
* Integrate segment submissions, challenge variances and assumptions, and resolve data or narrative inconsistencies before leadership reporting.
* Lead monthly and quarterly performance reviews, highlighting enterprise-level trends, risks, opportunities, and required actions.
* Prepare consolidated executive dashboards, management packs, and leadership-ready performance summaries.

Monthly Performance Management and Reporting
  
  

* Own monthly performance reporting, including actuals versus budget, forecast, prior year, and relevant operational drivers.
* Analyze cost, headcount, productivity, and run-rate trends to explain performance and identify corrective actions.
* Coordinate with Controllership and business finance teams to ensure timely and accurate close, flash reporting, and management reporting.
* Translate financial outcomes into concise insights and recommendations for finance and non-finance audiences.

Cost Optimization and Value Realization
  
  

* Lead governance and tracking of cost savings, productivity, and efficiency initiatives across supported areas.
* Validate initiative baselines, timing, ownership, financial impact, and sustainability of benefits.
* Monitor realized savings against commitments, identify delivery gaps, and facilitate mitigation plans with initiative owners.
* Identify new opportunities through benchmarking, spend analysis, process review, and cross-functional collaboration.

Business Cases and Decision Support
  
  

* Develop robust business cases for strategic investments, automation, location decisions, operating model changes, hiring, and transformation programs.
* Perform ROI, NPV, payback, sensitivity, and scenario analysis, with clear assumptions and decision recommendations.
* Assess financial and operational trade-offs and communicate implications to senior stakeholders.
* Provide ad hoc modeling and analysis for emerging business priorities.

Analytics, Automation and Finance Transformation
  
  

* Simplify and automate recurring finance processes, reporting packs, and data flows to improve speed, quality, and control.
* Develop intuitive Power BI dashboards and self-service reporting that connect financial and operational drivers.
* Partner with Technology and data teams to improve data integrity, scalable reporting architecture, and user adoption.
* Promote a forward-looking finance mindset by shifting effort from data compilation to insight generation and decision support.

Executive Storytelling and Communication
  
  

* Convert complex financial results into a clear, structured, and action-oriented business narrative.
* Prepare high-quality presentations and dashboards for senior management and US stakeholders.
* Explain financial concepts to non-finance audiences using simple language, relevant operational drivers, and focused visuals.
* Communicate issues early, distinguish facts from assumptions, and provide practical recommendations.

Governance and Team Leadership
  
  

* Ensure adherence to planning calendars, reporting timelines, policies, procedures, and internal controls.
* Lead cross-functional programs and coordinate contributors across locations without relying solely on formal authority.

title: Sr. Analyst, Competitive Pricing
description:
Our Company:
  
  
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Analyst, Competitive Pricing plays a critical role in shaping how Teradata competes in the market. This role is anchored in deep competitive pricing research that directly feeds into pricing analysis, recommendations, and approval — and extends that intelligence into field enablement that equips Sales and Deal Desk to compete and win on price.
  
  
Sitting within Teradata’s Product Marketing team, you will support the Pricing & Packaging team and will partner closely with Product Management, Competitive Intelligence, Product Marketing, Sales, and Deal Desk to build a fact-based view of competitor pricing — and translate those insights into actionable recommendations, pricing decisions, and field-ready tools.
  
  
This is a high-visibility role that directly influences pricing strategy, pricing approvals, deal execution, and competitive positioning.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Competitive Pricing Research
  
  

* Conduct structured competitive pricing analysis across cloud data platform, analytics, and AI competitors — covering list prices, discount patterns, packaging models, and consumption-based pricing structures.
* Build and maintain a competitive pricing intelligence database that serves as the authoritative source of record for Pricing & Packaging, Product Marketing, and Competitive Intelligence teams — including list prices, discount patterns, packaging models, and TCO benchmarks.
* Develop TCO and price‑performance models comparing Teradata to key competitors across regions, workloads, and deployment models.
* Analyze win/loss pricing patterns to identify risks and opportunities, and translate findings into concrete inputs for pricing recommendations and approval decisions.
* Monitor AI pricing and cloud monetization trends — token-based, consumption-based, and outcome-based models — and surface implications for Teradata’s pricing strategy and competitive positioning.
* Partner with Product Management and Product Marketing to ensure pricing strategy reflects current competitive realities and that research findings are integrated into packaging decisions and pricing recommendations.

Competitive Pricing Enablement
  
  

* Develop field-ready competitive pricing content — pricing briefs, battle cards, objection-handling guides, and deal-specific competitive summaries — grounded in research and immediately usable by Sales and Deal Desk.
* Build and maintain competitive pricing tools — including TCO calculators, price-performance comparison frameworks, and consumption model explainers — that Sales and Deal Desk can use in active opportunities.
* Translate win/loss pricing patterns into actionable field guidance — not just analysis, but competitive positioning and response playbooks that Sales can use in the next conversation.
* Support strategic and competitive deals with rapid-response competitive pricing analysis, negotiation framing, and custom TCO modeling tailored to specific account contexts.

**What You Bring**
Skills & Attributes
  
  

* Strong analytical and financial modeling skills; ability to turn complex data into crisp insights.
* Excellent communication skills; able to write clear, concise competitive briefs.
* Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast‑moving environment.
* Passion for the cloud, data, and AI ecosystem.
* Ability to build and leverage AI tools to automate repetitive analysis, improve accuracy, and increase the velocity of competitive insights.

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Math, Engineering, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in software, cloud, or data platforms, with demonstrated fluency in cloud and AI software pricing models (consumption-based, token-based, capacity-based, or SaaS subscription).
* Experience producing competitive analysis or pricing content that has been used directly by Sales, Deal Desk, or GTM Enablement teams.
* Ability to collaborate across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Finance.

**Preferred**

* MBA or advanced degree.
* Direct experience with cloud hyperscaler pricing (AWS, Azure, GCP) and/or AI/ML platform pricing from vendors such as Snowflake, Databricks, Google, or Microsoft.
* Familiarity with Teradata’s competitive landscape.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. title: Finance Executive
description:
About Nobero

Nobero is a fast-growing, tech-led D2C apparel brand focused on delivering everyday activewear and comfortable clothing to consumers. As we expand across multiple channels, including e-commerce, marketplaces, and Exclusive Brand Outlets (EBOs), we are looking for a detail-oriented, driven, and agile Finance Executive to manage day-to-day financial operations and reconciliation processes.

Role Overview

As a Finance Executive at Nobero, you will be responsible for brand-level financial operations, marketplace reconciliations, accounts receivable, vendor management, and statutory compliance tracking. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, external auditors, and key partners, including TMRW and KPMG, to ensure smooth cash flow, accurate bookkeeping, and timely compliance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Marketplace & B2B Operations

* **B2B Receivables & PO Validation:**
  Validate B2B Purchase Orders (POs) against agreed pricing and terms, and follow up on timely collections.
* **Proof of Delivery (POD) Management:**
  Track and collect B2B Proofs of Delivery (PODs) and maintain updated delivery trackers.
* **Credit Notes & IRNs:**
  Generate manual Credit Notes (CNs) and Invoice Reference Numbers (IRNs) for Return to Vendor (RTV) cases and B2B discount debits.
* **Stock Transfer IRNs:**
  Identify, process, and resolve pending Stock Transfer IRN cases to prevent tax and compliance discrepancies.

2. Cash, Expense & Retail Reconciliation

* **Marketplace Reconciliation:**
  Perform regular ledger and payout reconciliations across marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, and Myntra to ensure revenue accuracy and completeness.
* **EBO Cash/Card Reconciliation:**
  Monitor retail store petty cash accounts and perform weekly and monthly reconciliations of cash and card settlements.
* **Employee Reimbursements:**
  Validate and process employee business expenses through Enkash, following up on missing receipts and pending approvals.
* **Monthly Expense Analysis:**
  Assist with monthly expense variance analysis against budgets to identify discrepancies and cost-saving opportunities.

3. Vendor Management & Compliance

* **Vendor Payments:**
  Coordinate with vendors for invoice processing, ledger confirmations, and timely payment clearances.
* **PPOB/APOB Tracking:**
  Maintain and regularly update Principal Place of Business (PPOB) and Additional Place of Business (APOB) trackers across states, and follow up to resolve regulatory blocks.

Key Qualifications & Requirements

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce (B.Com), Finance, Accounting, or an equivalent discipline.
* M.Com or CA Inter qualification will be an added advantage.

Experience

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in financial operations, preferably within a D2C brand, e-commerce, retail, or apparel company.

Technical Skills

* Proficiency in accounting platforms such as Tally, Zoho, or ERP systems like SAP/NetSuite.
* Hands-on experience with expense management tools such as Enkash.
* Advanced MS Excel skills, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and data manipulation.
* Familiarity with GST compliance, e-invoicing (IRN), and e-Way bills.

Core Competencies

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Proactive follow-up and coordination skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

What We Offer

* An exciting opportunity to work with a fast-growing consumer D2C apparel brand.
* Direct exposure to e-commerce finance operations, marketplace reconciliation processes, and Big Four audit practices.
* Opportunities for professional growth, increased ownership, and collaboration within a dynamic finance team.

title: Finance System Integration Analyst
description:
**About SkySpecs:**

At SkySpecs, our mission is to simplify renewable asset management so less can do more for the planet. SkySpecs is making this possible by automating wind farm operations and maintenance with advanced robotics paired with our custom-built asset performance management software, Horizon.

SkySpecs launched the world’s first completely autonomous blade inspection product in 2016 with a custom-designed drone system. Since then, SkySpecs has inspected over 90% of the US wind turbines and expanded globally, becoming the world leader in understanding the health of turbine blades. Identifying issues with turbine blades is only the first step. In 2019, SkySpecs launched Horizon, a platform for SkySpecs to offer a multi-layered solution for customers that includes: data collection, wind turbine blade engineering expertise, and a place for all stakeholders to collaborate to manage and analyze massive amounts of data, spot trends, and create plans for high-cost repair campaigns. In 2021,

SkySpecs acquired two companies specializing in wind turbine drivetrain monitoring and financial management, further expanding our asset management portfolio. Ultimately, this will help reduce the cost and risk of operations for the industry.

**What will you be getting into?**

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Finance Systems Integration Analyst to support the implementation and ongoing operation of the Horizon Finance platform. This role will help coordinate integrations between outsourced service providers (OSPs), client accounting systems, and internal reporting platforms.

Working closely with the Portfolio Manager for Integrations, the successful candidate will support data onboarding, monitor integration progress, troubleshoot data issues, and help ensure financial data is accurately uploaded and processed within Horizon Finance.

The role sits at the intersection of finance, technology, and operations, and requires strong analytical, communication, and organisational skills.

**As a Finance Systems Integration Analyst, you will:**

* Assist with onboarding new outsourced service providers (OSPs) to the Horizon Finance platform.
* Coordinate the collection of financial data from external accounting systems.
* Support the mapping of charts of accounts between OSP systems and the Horizon Finance structure.
* Review uploaded financial data for completeness and accuracy.

**Data Management & Validation:**

* Assist in preparing and transforming financial datasets for upload into Horizon Finance.
* Perform quality checks on uploaded accounting data and bank statement files.
* Investigate and resolve data discrepancies or formatting issues.
* Maintain documentation of data structures, mappings, and integration processes.

**Operational Coordination:**

* Act as a point of contact for OSP integration queries and follow up on outstanding data requests.
* Track integration progress across multiple funds and service providers.
* Maintain integration timelines and task lists.
* Assist in organising training sessions and guidance materials for OSP users.

**Reporting & Analysis:**

* Support reconciliation and validation of financial information within the platform.
* Assist in monitoring integration performance and identifying opportunities for process improvement.
* Prepare internal updates on integration progress and key issues.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Help identify opportunities to streamline data ingestion and automation processes.
* Assist in testing new system features and enhancements within Horizon Finance.
* Support the development of best practices for financial and operational data integration.

**Requirements of the job:**

* 1–3 years of experience in finance operations, data analysis, or financial systems integration.
* Strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple integration processes and data onboarding timelines simultaneously.
* Solid analytical skills with experience in data mapping, reconciliation, and troubleshooting financial data discrepancies.
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving, evolving technology environment.

**Bonus Points:**

* Strong attention to detail and high accuracy in data entry
* Basic understanding of accounting principles or management accounts
* Solid comprehension of financial data structures and reporting
* Experience or interest in financial systems integration and technology

**Perks of the Job:**

* Time Off: Generous leave policy—among the best in the industry.
* Global Team: Work with teammates across 5 countries and diverse backgrounds.
* Impact: Help build the backbone of clean energy digital infrastructure.

title: Finance Manager, North America Transport Controllership
description:
**Description**
Amazon is seeking a Finance Manager to support Amazon Transportation Services, a leader in the global supply chain revolution through pioneering robotics, revolutionary automation initiatives, seeking sustainable solutions such as electric vehicles, and introducing one-day delivery for millions of products, in order to deliver billions of packages to delight customers.
  
  
The Finance Manager will own Financial Reporting and Analytics and ensure financial statements are correct in the transportation space for small parcels and last mile. Experience in this team opens up several career opportunities across Amazon. You will learn to produce insightful financial reporting, build robust and repeatable financial processes, controls, and perform in-depth analysis on transportation spend numbers. Given the nature of our business, you will learn to venture into unknown territory, and learn how to succeed in a new space.
  
  
This role partners across Transportation, Fulfillment, Supply Chain, and Technology teams to improve efficiencies while improving customer experience globally. This role works with business intelligence engineers, accountants, accounting managers, data engineers, program and product managers. This role creates a “learn by doing” environment by engaging with business and technology to promote and encourage continued customer focus. You will anticipate and resolve bottlenecks while balancing business needs and escalating where appropriate.
  
  
The successful candidate has demonstrated the following abilities: ability to develop insights using activity based costing, data analysis, econometrics, and statistics, and excellent verbal and written communication. This role will work in a dynamic environment working with some of the world's largest data sets in logistics costing. As such, the Finance Manager must combine excellent business analysis skills with the ability to derive actionable cost measures for consumption across Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Uses solid financial knowledge and business acumen to build financial models, interpret data, draw conclusions, and make recommendations that deliver results, drive improvements, and influence leaders throughout Amazon. These decisions can have global impact.
* Delivers weekly/monthly financial close. Uses financial systems, SQL, and advanced MSExcel functions to work with large data sets. Outputs analytical dashboards and reports, plans, forecasts, budgets, and consolidations.
* Drives continuous improvement and standardization of processes, including implementation of best practices in the controllership area.
* Supports financial reporting and operating planning, demonstrating finance acumen and ability to quickly adapt to different business needs.
* Prepares concise documents, tailored to various levels of stakeholders, and collaborates with operations’ leaders and other teams.
* Uses active listening skills intuitively to communicate data (both written and verbal) in a clear, concise, and unambiguous manner. Adjusts style for various audiences to articulate complex finance issues clearly.
* Collects and analyzes quantitative data to develop relevant reports that drive cost reductions.
* Participates in hiring, developing, and mentoring peers and team members. Seeks and leverages diverse perspectives in all activities.
* Identifies opportunities to resolve defects proactively. Improves, scales, or simplifies finance tools across teams and organizations.

A day in the life
  
  
The Finance Manager blends advanced reporting, data analysis, critical thinking and project management skills while understanding and further developing financial applications. A typical day in this role provides an opportunity to resolve ambiguous problems, build analytical dashboards and reports, own month end close deliverables, work with tech partners to resolve technical issues and ensure successful accounting automation launch for month end close processes.
  
  
**About The Team**
Transportation Controllership is a global finance team responsible for Financial Reporting activities, establishing Financial Control Frameworks and Advanced Analytics in the transportation space, including import, domestic inbound, warehouse transfer, and outbound shipments. We partner closely with transportation business units and tech teams as they work to continually refine and scale the business to keep pace with Amazon's rapid growth. Along with our partners in Accounting, we are responsible for the contractual and managerial closing of the books for Transportation spend.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* 5+ years of multiple finance and accounting roles experience
* 6+ years of Accounts Receivable or Account Payable experience
* 6+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
* 6+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
* 6+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
* 6+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics or business, or Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of quantitative role (engineering, process re-engineering, quality assurance) experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
* 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
* MBA, or CPA
* Knowledge of SQL/ETL
* Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
* Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, financial modeling, and financial systems, including SAP and reporting or analytics platforms

description:
**Executive — Accounts, Admin & HR Support**
Zono Tradetech Pvt. Ltd. (ZoTok.ai)
  
  

* Hyderabad

🧾 Tally-First Accounts Role
  
  

* 🏢 Admin & Office Support
* 🎬 HR & Social Media Enthusiasm
* 1.5–3 Years Experience

**About Zotok.ai**
ZoTok.ai is India's first AI-driven conversational commerce engine on WhatsApp — helping Brands, Distributors and Retailers digitise their order-to-cash flows. We are a fast-growing B2B SaaS product company headquartered in Hyderabad with a team of 80+ and growing.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a sharp, enthusiastic and well-rounded Executive whose core strength is in Accounts — someone who is hands-on with Tally, keeps books clean, and ensures nothing in billing or payments is missed. Beyond that, you will support day-to-day office administration, and bring genuine energy to HR support and employee engagement — including creating fun content for our Instagram and LinkedIn.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who is not looking to be boxed in — someone who enjoys variety, takes initiative and wants to be a visible, contributing member of a lively team.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**▸ Tally & Bookkeeping:**
Manage all day-to-day accounting entries in Tally — sales, purchase, receipts, payments, journal entries and bank reconciliation. This is your primary responsibility.
  
  
**▸ Invoice & Bill Processing:**
Collect, verify and process all vendor invoices and bills. Ensure timely entries and follow up with Finance for approvals and payments.
  
  
**▸ Petty Cash Management:**
Handle petty cash disbursements, maintain accurate daily records and submit timely reports.
  
  
**▸ Expense Tracking & Reconciliation:**
Track office expenses, record transactions and support monthly reconciliation with accuracy.
  
  
**▸ GST & Compliance Support:**
Assist with GST data compilation, TDS records and other statutory compliance documentation as directed by the Finance team.
  
  
**▸ Audit Readiness:**
Maintain well-organised records of bills, receipts, vouchers and agreements for audit and compliance purposes.
  
  
**▸ Vendor Coordination:**
Coordinate with vendors for supplies, maintenance and services. Collect invoices, follow up on deliveries and ensure timely closures.
  
  
**▸ Office Upkeep:**
Oversee day-to-day office operations — housekeeping, facility coordination and ensuring a clean, functional workspace.
  
  
**▸ Stock & Stationery Management:**
Maintain stock of office supplies and stationery. Monitor inventory levels and raise purchase requests before items run out.
  
  
**▸ Asset Register:**
Maintain an accurate register of office and IT assets — issuance, returns and condition tracking.
  
  
**▸ Other Admin Support:**
Assist with courier and dispatch, travel coordination, visitor management and any general office requirements as needed.
  
  
**▸ HR Support:**
Assist HR in employee documentation, record maintenance, attendance coordination and onboarding/exit formalities.
  
  
**▸ Employee Engagement Activities:**
Help plan and execute fun team activities, celebrations, birthday shoutouts and office events — your energy and ideas are welcome here.
  
  
**▸ Social Media Content:**
This is where your enthusiasm matters — capture moments from team events, celebrations and office life, and create fun, engaging posts and short videos for ZoTok's Instagram and LinkedIn. A creative eye and comfort with Reels/Shorts is a big plus.
  
  
**▸ Internal Engagement Posts:**
Coordinate with HR for milestone posts, anniversary shoutouts, new joiner welcomes and achievement callouts to keep the team spirit alive online.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**
**▸ Experience:**
1.5–3 years in an accounts role with hands-on Tally experience. Exposure to admin or HR support is an advantage.
  
  
**▸ Education:**
B.Com, BBA or any graduate. Commerce background preferred.
  
  
**▸ Tally:**
Proficiency in Tally ERP / Tally Prime is essential — non-negotiable.
  
  
**▸ Accounts Knowledge:**
Working knowledge of GST basics, TDS, petty cash, bank reconciliation and expense tracking.
  
  
**▸ MS Office:**
Comfortable with Excel, Word and Google Sheets for day-to-day tracking and reporting.
  
  
**▸ Social Media Enthusiasm:**
Active on Instagram and LinkedIn. Comfortable creating short videos, Reels or fun posts. Formal design training not required — a creative instinct and willingness to try is what matters.
  
  
**▸ Attitude:**
Organised, proactive and cheerful. Someone who genuinely enjoys being around people and contributing to a positive office culture.
  
  
**▸ Communication:**
Good verbal and written communication in English and Telugu / Hindi.
  
  
**WHY ZOTOK?**
You will not be a back-office person here. Your accounts work keeps the company running, your admin support keeps the office humming, and your energy on social media keeps the team proud. If you want a role where your work is noticed across all three — this is it.
  
  
www.zotok.ai

**Job Summary**
InterScripts Software Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced

The ideal candidate will possess strong functional expertise in Workday Financials, including configuration, implementation, business process optimization, financial reporting, and production support. The role involves collaborating with finance stakeholders, business users, and technical teams to understand business requirements and deliver effective Workday solutions aligned with organizational objectives.
  
  
Candidates should have excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, along with the ability to collaborate effectively with US-based teams during Eastern business hours.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Workday Financials Configuration and Support
* Configure, maintain, and support Workday Financial Management modules based on business requirements.
* Work with General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Procurement, Expenses, and Fixed Assets.
* Configure business processes, approval workflows, accounting rules, financial dimensions, and security roles.
* Troubleshoot functional issues and recommend appropriate solutions and process improvements.
* Support Workday Financials enhancements, system updates, and ongoing optimization.
* Business Requirements and Functional Analysis
* Collaborate with finance teams, business stakeholders, and end users to gather and analyze business requirements.
* Translate business needs into functional specifications and Workday configuration designs.
* Perform gap analysis and recommend solutions aligned with finance processes and business objectives.
* Document business processes, configuration decisions, functional requirements, and solution designs.
* Identify opportunities to streamline and improve financial processes.
* Financial Processes and Reporting
* Support key finance processes, including:

+ Record-to-Report (R2R)
+ Procure-to-Pay (P2P)
+ Order-to-Cash (O2C)
+ Financial accounting and period-end close
+ Expense management and supplier payments

* Support financial reporting, accounting structures, reconciliations, and data validation.
* Ensure financial data accuracy and adherence to internal controls and compliance requirements.
* Assist with developing and maintaining Workday reports and dashboards.
* Implementation, Testing, and Deployment
* Participate in Workday Financials implementations, rollouts, and enhancement projects.
* Support configuration, data migration, and financial data validation activities.
* Prepare and execute functional test scenarios, including System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Identify defects, coordinate resolutions, and validate fixes.
* Support deployment, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization activities.
* Integrations and Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Collaborate with technical teams to support Workday integrations, reporting requirements, and data exchange.
* Coordinate with other Workday functional teams to address cross-module dependencies.
* Resolve production issues and provide timely functional support.
* Conduct end-user training and prepare functional documentation, process guides, and knowledge-transfer materials.

**Requirements**
  
  

* 5+ years of relevant experience in Workday Financials, Workday Finance functional consulting, or related ERP finance consulting.
* Strong functional knowledge of Workday Financial Management.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of the following modules:

+ General Ledger (GL)
+ Accounts Payable (AP)
+ Accounts Receivable (AR)
+ Procurement
+ Expenses
+ Fixed Assets

* Strong understanding of finance and accounting processes, including R2R, P2P, and O2C.
* Experience with Workday business process configuration, functional analysis, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Experience in Workday Financials implementation, enhancement, or production support projects.
* Knowledge of financial reporting, accounting structures, and internal financial controls.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work effectively with US-based stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

title: Senior Associate - Global Distribution Finance
description:
**Summary**
The Senior Associate - Global Distribution Finance supports Global Distribution financial planning, forecasting, reporting, purchase-order management, invoice and payment management, and control activities across the network. The role consolidates budget and forecast inputs, analyzes actual spending and key drivers, and prepares clear financial insights for Global Distribution hubs, Finance partners, and leadership.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the collection of annual budget, quarterly forecast, monthly outlook, and year-end estimate inputs from Global Distribution hubs and functional teams.
* Consolidate budget assumptions, spending forecasts, actuals, and supporting commentary into a complete Global Distribution financial view.
* Review monthly actual spending, accruals, and open commitments with Finance and budget owners to support accurate financial reporting and forecast updates.
* Perform variance, trend, and scenario analysis to explain changes in distribution and logistics spend, identify emerging risks, and highlight opportunities for action.
* Prepare recurring reports, dashboards, variance bridges, and executive summaries that translate complex financial data into clear business insights.
* Track productivity initiatives and savings projects, validate supporting assumptions, monitor performance against commitments, and escalate material variances.
* Manage purchase requisition and purchase order creation for logistics and distribution services. Validate budget availability and create purchase orders through Ariba and SAP procurement processes.
* Manage purchase order approvals by routing requests through the appropriate workflow and ensuring compliance with spending thresholds and established controls.
* Communicate approved purchase orders to suppliers and confirm supplier acknowledgement of the order and related commitment.
* Manage invoice and payment activities for logistics and distribution services by confirming that goods were received or services were performed before invoice approval.
* Review and approve invoices in accordance with established controls, resolve invoice mismatches with suppliers and internal stakeholders, and support timely accounts payable processing.
* Support assessment of project timelines, operational changes, and network initiatives to ensure financial implications are reflected in forecasts and planning submissions.
* Identify opportunities to improve planning tools, reporting processes, data quality, and automation; support implementation of approved improvements.
* Complete all work in accordance with applicable cGMP requirements, Amgen procedures, and financial control standards.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field and 5 to 9 years of directly related experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience in financial planning and analysis, budgeting, forecasting, operational finance, supply chain analytics, or a comparable analytical role.
* Advanced Excel and/or Smartsheet skills, including formulas, pivot tables, data modeling, and analysis of large datasets.
* Ability to consolidate information from multiple stakeholders, identify data inconsistencies, and deliver accurate outputs within planning-cycle deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain financial results to non-finance stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and maintain attention to detail in a global, cross-functional environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, or financial close processes in a supply chain, manufacturing, distribution, or operations environment.
* Experience with SAP or other financial and enterprise resource planning systems.
* Experience with Smartsheet, Power BI, Tableau, or comparable reporting and visualization tools.
* Experience tracking savings initiatives, productivity projects, or operational cost-reduction programs.
* Knowledge of project management concepts, including milestones, change control, and financial impact assessment.

Competencies and Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn data into practical recommendations.
* Working knowledge of financial governance, controls, and the relationship between operational drivers and financial results.
* Clear presentation and technical-writing skills for leadership reports, meeting materials, and financial commentary.
* Collaborative stakeholder-management skills and the ability to work effectively across regions and functions.
* Sound judgment, accountability, and a continuous-improvement mindset.
* Alignment with Amgen Values and Leadership Attributes.

Working Relationships and Scope
  
  
The Senior Associate - Global Distribution Finance works closely with Global Distribution hubs, functional teams, and finance partners. The role receives assignments in task- and objective-oriented terms and is expected to independently manage recurring analyses, reporting activities, and follow-up actions within established processes. The position does not have direct people-management responsibility but is expected to influence timely completion of financial inputs and corrective actions through effective partnership and communication.

title: P&BP CoE Assistant Manager
description:
**About Us**
We’re Reckitt, home to the world’s best loved and trusted hygiene and health brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
  
  
Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
**About The Finance Planning & Reporting CoE**
Driving efficiency and standardization across our renowned consumer brands that enhance everyday lives—from nourishing meals to trusted household essentials—is the pivotal force of the Finance Planning & Reporting Center of Excellence (CoE). Fuelled by a culture of collaboration and innovation, the CoE is integral to our organization, championing financial excellence and strategic insight across our global landscape. We are a dynamic, agile team, relentlessly focused on enhancing our financial processes, harnessing advanced analytics, and delivering unparalleled value to every facet of our business.
  
  
We transcend traditional finance roles; we are a strategic partner where diverse talents converge to tackle intricate financial challenges, foster sustainable growth, and empower our mission to create a healthier, more sustainable world for all. By ensuring a clear line of sight between strategic goals and day-to-day financial activities, we enable efficient performance management and better business results through the collaboration of our people, processes, and systems.
  
  
Our CoE transforms finance from a traditional back-office function into a strategic powerhouse that drives business value, as talented individuals come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better business.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Assistant Manager - Planning & Reporting CoE, you will report into a Finance Manager and be part of a team of analysts supporting a portfolio of markets. In this role, you will play a key part in executing financial planning and reporting activities across these markets. You will support the creation of standardized reports, development of initial forecasts/budgets, and analysis of financial performance to enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
This position offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure to multiple markets while contributing to the centralization and improvement of Reckitt’s FP&A processes. If you are passionate about finance, data analysis, and continuous improvement, this role will allow you to grow and make a real impact on our global business.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Build and maintain standard reporting packs for various stakeholders, ensuring that key performance metrics are accurately captured and delivered on time to support informed decision-making.
* Manage the publication of dashboards and reports, enhancing financial visibility and ensuring timely delivery of insights that reflect current performance and trends.
* Conduct ad hoc analyses to support business decisions and strategic initiatives, providing clear explanations of variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) and highlighting key drivers behind the numbers.
* Automate forecasting processes and support planning cycle activities, coordinating data collection from various markets, validating submissions, and aligning assumptions with global guidelines to create a cohesive financial outlook.
* Provide scenario templates and centrally modelled assumptions for planning, ensuring consistency in reporting and analytics practices across teams to maintain data integrity.
* Collaborate closely with market finance teams and other CoE members to ensure a single source of truth in our financial systems, acting as a liaison to help local teams understand CoE processes and troubleshoot any data or reporting issues.
* Participate in finance transformation initiatives by identifying opportunities to streamline and improve existing FP&A processes, contributing to the standardization of report templates and the automation of manual tasks to enhance efficiency.
* Assist with ad-hoc analysis and projects as needed, such as deep-dives into specific expenses or trends, scenario modelling for strategic projects, or preparing financial decks for senior leadership meetings, turning data into actionable insights.
* Adapt and excel in a dynamic environment, demonstrating agility and teamwork while managing last-minute changes or requests, especially during key reporting periods, and maintaining a high standard of quality in all deliverables.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* 6+ years of experience in finance, reporting, or analytics, with a preference for CPG industry experience.
* Strong analytical skills with a focus on data interpretation and presentation.
* Familiarity with financial planning and analysis processes.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
* Proficiency in reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel) and financial modelling.

The skills for success
  
  

* Financial Analysis & Reporting
* Strategic Planning
* Business Partnering
* Process Improvement
* Data Visualization Skills
* Project Management
* Team Leadership
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Change Management
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Manager/Sr. Manager - FP&A (NBFC/HFC/Bank Only)
description:
We are hiring for a leading Home finance industry.

**Candidates from NBFC/Banking/HFC industry ONLY APPLY. Projects from NBFC/Banking/HFC industry/client will not be considered.**

**Role - Manager/Sr. Manager - FP&A**

**Location - Hyderabad**

**Experience - 4+ years exp in FP&A.**

**Industry - Must have experience in NBFC/HFC/Banking industry.**

Qualification - CA/CMA preferred.

**Objective (Purpose of the Job)**

Seeking a highly analytical finance professional to drive FP&A, business performance and strategic financial analytics. The role will own financial planning, profitability analysis, management MIS, forecasting and performance evaluation, while providing insights through peer benchmarking, financial ratio analysis and capital-markets / IPO-related analytics.

**Key Responsibilities**

* FP&A & Financial Planning – Own the Company’s financial model, annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, long-range planning and scenario analysis.
* Profitability Analysis – Conduct detailed profitability analysis at product, branch, geography and business-unit levels; identify opportunities for pricing, cost optimisation and revenue enhancement.
* Performance Management – Track actual performance against budget, prior period and business plan; analyse key drivers and recommend corrective actions.
* **Business & Financial Analytics – Analyse P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow performance and interpret key lending/NBFC ratios including NIM, yield, spread, ROA, ROE, cost-to-income, leverage, capital adequacy, liquidity and asset-quality metrics.**
* **Peer Benchmarking – Benchmark business, financial and operating metrics against relevant NBFC/HFC peers; identify performance gaps, trends and best practices.**
* Management MIS & Decision Support – Develop concise management dashboards and performance packs, with clear commentary on business drivers, risks and opportunities.
* Capital Markets / IPO Exposure – Support IPO readiness and capital-market initiatives through financial and operating metric analysis, peer benchmarking, valuation-related analysis, investor presentations and management/investor information requirements.
* Strategic Analytics – Evaluate product economics, pricing, branch expansion, cost structures, capital allocation and other strategic business decisions.
* ALM & Balance Sheet Analytics – Support forecasting of funding, liquidity, AUM, disbursements and Dynamic ALM, and assess their impact on profitability and capital.
* Cost Control & Efficiency – Monitor operating costs against budgets, identify efficiency opportunities and support business teams in delivering financial targets.
* **BI & Automation – Leverage Excel, BI and data-analysis tools to automate recurring MIS, improve reporting quality and enable drill-down analysis.**

**Educational Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or related field.
* CA / CFA / CMA / MBA or equivalent professional qualification preferred.

**Experience**

* **4–8 years of experience in FP&A, business finance, financial planning, financial analysis or related roles, preferably in NBFC / HFC / banking / financial services.**
* **Strong experience in financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting, profitability analysis and management reporting.**
* Exposure to peer benchmarking, financial ratio analysis and interpretation of lending / financial-services metrics.
* Exposure to IPO, capital markets, investor reporting or transaction-related financial analysis will be an advantage.
* **Familiarity with NBFC regulations, lending products, ALM and industry-specific financial metrics preferred.**

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong analytical and financial modelling skills with advanced Excel proficiency.
* Ability to interpret financial statements, business metrics and key financial ratios and translate them into actionable insights.
* **Strong understanding of NBFC / lending business economics and profitability drivers.**
* Ability to benchmark peers and understand business performance in the context of industry trends.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights clearly to senior management.
* **Working knowledge of BI / data visualisation tools and ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle or equivalent.**

title: Asset Manager - Fund Accounting - Team Lead
description:
****Job Description****
The main function of the role is: Work in conjunction with individuals on the team as well as other Shared Services/COEs, outsource partners, Client Operations, other business units as needed to ensure seamless processing according to the fund’s policies, to ensure NAV/yield accuracy and that all SLAs are met.
  
  
**Shifts: North America (Night Shifts)**
****What You Will Be Responsible For:****
As Senior Associate you will:
  
  

* Manage the day-to-day activities of a functional/oversight team by monitoring, reviewing and validating all daily activity to ensure accuracy and timeliness in calculations and processing, as well as adherence to controls, e.g. ensuring accurate g/l and/or balance for daily pricing
* Provide timely accurate management reporting and issue log maintenance, under moderate supervision
* Research and resolve exceptions and issues
* Escalate unresolved issues to management as required
* Reconcile and resolve discrepancies with other Shared Service teams, external clients and Client Operations as needed
* Ensure all inquiries are resolved in a timely and accurate manner and communicates effectively with client when necessary
* Ensure appropriate records of daily and monthly activities are kept
* Coordinate effective and timely flow of critical information to all relevant parties and follows up on administrative details within the department
* Oversee the adherence to Standard Operating Procedures
* Maintain knowledge of current alternative procedures and processes
* Assist with workflow management and technology enhancement, make suggestions to streamline operations
* Document any updates or changes to formal procedures, databases, etc.
* Participate in projects as well as prepare and verify information for those various projects/special requests as directed
* Train, develop and motivate new staff and complete performance appraisals
* Provide staffing recommendations by interviewing new personnel
* Coordinate and supervise work efforts when multiple Associates are needed to complete work
* Provide coaching and development opportunities to staff, participate in individual on-going training and development
* Has accountability and responsibility for completing and delivering PPRs on time
* Make effective recommendations to hire, discipline, control work and terminate employment
* Make effective recommendations for promotions, salary increases and bonuses.
* During the course of normal day to day operations, responsible for identifying any unusual or potentially suspicious transaction activity and must report and/or escalate in accordance with corporate policy and guidelines detailed in relevant operating procedures.
* Perform duties of Associates if required, perform other duties as assigned.

****What We Value:****
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  
****Competencies:****

* Client focus: – Act as a focal point of contact to maintain strong client relationship; actively participate in internal and client meetings. Respond to client queries.
* Leadership Focus – Leverage experience and technical expertise to support peers globally by providing guidance and training, and fully support and participate in all aspects of employee engagement.
* Operational Efficiency Focus: Actively participate in an efficient and effective global operating model, collaborating with peers globally, and using standard technology, best practices, and optimal functions.
* Performance Focus: Provide excellent service to clients through a results-oriented mindset
* Quality & Risk Focus: Understand and minimize risk through adhering to standard and client specific operating procedures and through broad participation in the global training program. Focus on qualitative work, attention to detail with a thorough understanding of business impact and ways to minimize risk

****Mandatory Skill Sets:****

* Good understanding of financial services and investment products
* Excellent Communication Skills
* Problem Solving & Analytical Skills
* Ability to work on MS Office (Excel, Word and PPT)

****Additional Skill Sets:****

* Good understanding of financial services and investment products.
* Strong attention to detail and a focus on service.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities to meet internal and industry deadlines.
* Ability to perform under pressure and manage high volumes.
* Committed to learn technical aspects of each deliverable.
* Ability to communicate with various internal teams to resolve queries and escalate accordingly.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, organizational, and time management skills.
* Demonstrates an ability to be a leader within their team, as well as be a leader amongst your peers.

****Education & Preferred Qualifications:****

* Graduate degree in Business, Accounting, Finance or equivalent experience preferred
* 6+ years of experience in related accounting or finance field preferred
* Should be comfortable working in North America Shifts

****About State Street****
What we do. State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.
  
  
**Work, Live and Grow.**
We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary in locations, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.
  
  
****About State Street****
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
