title: Research Analyst
description:
**About 79th East** 




 79th East Private Limited is a Hyderabad\-based investment services firm – an AMFI\-registered Mutual Fund Distributor (ARN\-364145\) and a distributor of Portfolio Management Services. Our work is research\-led: we build our own view on funds and stocks rather than passing on someone else's.
 



**The role** 




 You will build and maintain the firm's internal view of markets, funds and stocks. This research is for our own use – it shapes what we recommend and how we guide clients. It is hands\-on analytical work from day one, not a support role.
 



**Key responsibilities** 



* Mutual fund due diligence – category comparisons, factsheet and portfolio analysis, performance and risk attribution, and maintaining the recommended\-fund list.
* Single\-stock analysis – screening, financial analysis and sector work, to our house factsheet format.
* Support the equity basket products: construction, periodic review and reconciliation.
* Client portfolio analysis – overlap and look\-through studies, rebalancing notes and investment\-committee notes.
* Draft investor\-facing material – the monthly market letter, blog articles and webinar content – in plain, accurate language.
* Keep the research process documented and repeatable, with every figure traceable to its source.



**What you must bring** 



* Valid NISM Series XV (Research Analyst) certificate – mandatory.
* 2–3 years in equity or mutual fund research, or a research\-facing role at a broking house, AMC, wealth firm or research provider.
* Strong Excel and financial analysis; comfortable building and auditing a model.
* Ability to write clearly for a non\-specialist reader.
* Graduate in commerce, finance or economics.
* Hyderabad local candidates only – the role is on\-site at Ameerpet.



**Added advantage** 



* NISM Series V\-A, VIII or XXI\-A.
* CFA (any level), FRM or MBA (Finance).
* Screener, Capitaline, Ace Equity, Bloomberg or similar research tools.
* Working knowledge of AI tools such as Claude.
* Proficiency in Telugu and/or Hindi.



**Location and salary** 



* Location: Ameerpet, Hyderabad – full\-time, on\-site.
* Salary: up to Rs 5,00,000 per year (CTC), based on experience.



**How to apply** 




 Email your CV to info@79the.com with the subject "Research Analyst – Hyderabad", mentioning the validity date of your NISM Series XV certificate. If you can share one research note or model you have written, please attach it.
 



 79th East Private Limited is an equal\-opportunity employer.

title: Associate Director, Technical Project Management, Investment Manager
description:
****Job Description****
**Associate Director, Technical Project Management, Investment Manager**
**The Opportunity**
 Join a global biopharma company with a 130\-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of technology driven, data\-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats. Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. Each Tech Center is supported by a focused group of leaders who invest in the well\-being of our people and work together across locations to optimize global connections and continuously share and improve best practices. This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
   

  

****Role Overview****
 As an Associate Director and Investment Manager within the Technical Project Management family, you will lead the financial governance, budget operations, and backoffice administration for our technical delivery teams. You will essentially "run the books" for the organization, driving end\-to\-end management of capital and operational budgets, cost forecasts, actuals tracking, and financial compliance. You will collaborate closely with technical project managers, engineering leads, and finance partners to ensure resource allocation, vendor contracts, and portfolio spend are fully optimized and transparent. Utilizing your financial acumen and analytical skills, you will translate complex financial data into actionable insights and strategic recommendations for senior leadership.
   

  

****What Will You Do In This Role****
* Run the Books Manage and govern the end\-to\-end technical department/portfolio budget, including forecasting, cost tracking, variance analysis, and regular financial reporting.
* Financial Forecasting \& Planning Partner with project and engineering leads to align quarterly/annual financial forecasts with delivery roadmaps, ensuring accurate cost estimations and capitalization models.
* Vendor \& Procurement Coordination Manage the backoffice procurement pipeline, driving the end\-to\-end processing of Statements of Work (SOWs), Purchase Orders (POs), vendor invoicing, and contract tracking.
* Resource and Demand Tracking Track operational team needs, manage headcount planning models, and oversee onboarding metrics to ensure correct financial allocation.
* Financial Transparency \& Reporting Design, build, and maintain real\-time financial dashboards and KPIs to provide the leadership team with visibility into overall run\-rate and project\-specific ROI.
* Capitalization and Compliance Ensure all project expenditures comply with internal accounting policies, corporate governance guidelines, and software capitalization rules (CapEx vs. OpEx).
* Cost Optimization Analyze existing spend patterns, infrastructure usage, and license costs to proactively identify cost\-savings or optimization opportunities.
* Stakeholder Management Present financial summaries, budget health metrics, and risk mitigation strategies clearly during leadership business reviews.
* Process Improvement Standardize and automate backoffice financial tracking procedures, reducing manual efforts across technical project teams.
* Mentorship Provide guidance to project managers and team leads on financial processes, procurement guidelines, and budget management tools


****What Should You Have****
 Educational requirement is mandatory. Skills are separated into Primary and Secondary – this structure must be maintained to support HiredScore screening.
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related technology field.
* 10\-14 years of professional experience, with a significant track record in IT financial management, portfolio budget coordination, or technical business operations.


****Required Skills****
* Financial Operations \& Bookkeeping Mastery in budgeting, forecasting, actuals tracking, variance analysis, and CapEx/OpEx management within an IT or engineering setting.
* Procurement \& Contract Operations Proven experience managing the lifecycle of SOWs, Purchase Orders, and interfacing with Procurement, Finance, and external vendors.
* Advanced Financial Tools High\-level proficiency in MS Excel (advanced modeling, pivot tables, forecasting functions) and enterprise resource tools (e.g., SAP, portfolio management systems, or Clarity).
* Resource Demand Planning Hands\-on experience tracking headcount, managing operational demand capacity, and aligning resource plans to financial budgets.
* Analytical Skills Strong ability to synthesize large volumes of financial data into clear, visual dashboards and executive summaries.
* Stakeholder Communication Excellent interpersonal skills to effectively liaise with both technical leaders and finance controllers.


****Primary Skills (Must Have)****
* Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A)
* Budgeting \& Forecasting
* Variance Analysis
* CapEx / OpEx Management
* SAP
* Procurement \& Purchase Orders (PO)
* Statement of Work (SOW)
* Resource Demand Planning
* Financial Modeling
* Advanced Excel
* Stakeholder Management
* Investment Management


****Secondary Skills (Nice To Have)****
* MBA, Certified Management Accountant (CMA), PMP, or related financial and project certifications.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery frameworks and how modern software delivery impact budgeting cycles.


****Who We Are****
 We are known as well\-known org Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
   

  

****What We Look For****
 Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time.  Key Activities

* Track customer feedback, service\-related issues, and improvement opportunities to help drive positive customer outcomes.

**What you will bring** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* Mining Engineering, Mineral Engineering, or other engineering qualifications will be highly regarded.
* Engineering graduates and early\-career professionals are strongly encouraged to apply.
* Experience in mining, mining services, technical services, commercial support, account management, planning, business analysis, or customer\-facing roles is advantageous.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational and commercial data.
* Understanding of mining operations, drill and blast activities, production environments, or resource industries will be highly regarded.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and confidence working with data, reporting, and performance metrics.
* Experience with SAP, ERP systems, Power BI, or similar business systems is advantageous.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* A proactive mindset and willingness to build a career at the intersection of operations, customer engagement, and commercial performance.



  





**What we offer** 




  





 As part of a truly global company, you will have the ability to grow and learn in a diverse, collaborative culture. We foster relationships and learning through connected global and local teams, promote flexible and diverse career paths and support the development of your knowledge and skills.
 



  





 You will be paid a competitive salary, learn from talented individuals across multiple disciplines and be able to thrive in a safe workplace within a collaborative culture. Ignite your career at a place where your distinct potential can find its home.
 



  





**We respect and value all** 




  





 Orica promotes and fosters a culture of inclusion and Equal Opportunity Employment everywhere we operate. We treat our people and applicants with fairness, dignity, and respect, getting the best of everyone’s contributions. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, nationality, age, military or veteran, marital or disability status.

title: USA Properties Business Manager
description:
**PRIME DEVELOPERS US** 




*Job Description* 




**Property Business Manager** 




*(Based at Hyderabad Office, India \| Managing One US Commercial Property)* 




**Company** 





 Prime Developers – Texas\-based commercial real estate developer/owner\-operator (est. 2017\), managing retail, flex, and office plaza properties across Austin, Cedar Park, Leander, and Lewisville, TX.
 




**Location** 





 Hyderabad Office, India – in\-office role
 




**Scope** 





 One assigned US commercial property
 




**Reports To** 





 Company Leadership / Ownership
 




**Direct Reports** 





 On\-site Property Manager and ground staff at the assigned property
 




**Work Hours** 





 Overlap with US business hours (Central Time) required
 




**Reporting Cadence** 





 Regular reports to leadership on occupancy, maintenance, and financial performance
 




**About Prime Developers** 





 Prime Developers has offered real estate development and investment services since 2017, specializing in iconic commercial and residential properties across the Texas market. The company owns and operates a growing portfolio of multi\-tenant retail, flex, and office plazas, and is actively acquiring additional commercial spaces — creating an expanding need for hands\-on, accountable operational oversight across the portfolio.
 




**Role Overview** 





 Prime Developers is looking for a Property Business Manager, based at the company's Hyderabad office, to take full ownership of the day\-to\-day wellbeing, performance, and growth of one assigned US commercial property. This is not a ground\-up development role — the focus is on operating, maintaining, and growing an established building/commercial space after acquisition or completion.
 





 The person in this role will act as the single point of accountability for the assigned property, directing and coordinating an on\-site Property Manager and ground staff based in the US, while personally owning leasing/bookings, maintenance oversight, marketing, accounting coordination, and overall growth of the asset. Regular reports will be shared with leadership on occupancy, maintenance, and financial performance.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Own the end\-to\-end performance of the assigned commercial property — treat it like a business unit with full accountability for its upkeep and growth.
 



 • Exercise decision\-making authority on growth\-oriented initiatives for the property — leasing terms, budget allocation, capex, vendor contracts — and be able to justify each decision with clear financial and operational reasoning.
 **(This will discuss with client)** 




 • Direct and coordinate the on\-site Property Manager and ground staff (maintenance, leasing/front\-desk, vendors) from the Hyderabad office.
 



 • Oversee bookings, leasing, and occupancy — track vacancies, tenant renewals, and new leasing opportunities to maximize occupancy and revenue.
 



 • Manage maintenance operations — schedule repairs and preventive maintenance, track work orders, and ensure ground staff/vendors resolve issues promptly.
 



 • Coordinate accounting and financial oversight — track rent collection, operating expenses, budgets, and P\&L for each property in partnership with accounting/finance resources.
 **(If Applicable)** 




 • Drive marketing and growth initiatives — improve property visibility, tenant mix, and occupancy through marketing efforts and local partnerships.
 



 • Manage vendor and contractor relationships — sourcing, negotiating, and overseeing US\-based vendors for repairs, landscaping, security, and other services.
 **(Client Decision)** 




 • Ensure compliance with US property regulations, local codes, licensing, and insurance requirements applicable to each property.
 **(If applicable/required)** 




 • Provide regular reporting to leadership on occupancy, financial performance, maintenance status, and growth initiatives for the property.
 



 • Be ready to take on additional properties and support onboarding/operational setup as the company's portfolio grows.
 



**Requirements** 




 • MBA in Finance (or equivalent) with 2–3 years of relevant experience, including a demonstrated track record of making business/financial decisions and justifying them with sound reasoning and data.
 



 • Prior experience in property management, facilities management, or commercial real estate operations (US market experience strongly preferred but not mandate).
 



 • Demonstrated ability to manage a team remotely and hold on\-site staff accountable without being physically present at the property.
 



 • Working knowledge of leasing/occupancy management, basic accounting/P\&L, and vendor management.
 



 • Strong written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable working significant overlap with US business hours.
 



 • Familiarity with property management or leasing software (e.g., AppFolio, Buildium, or similar) is a plus.
 **(These are software’s recommended but its client decision)** 



* • Highly organized, ownership\-driven mindset — comfortable being the accountable owner of an asset's outcomes rather than just a coordinator.

title: Senior Manager,  International Controllership
description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***








**Who We Are…**





 When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the
 *storytellers* 
 bringing our characters to life, the
 *creators* 
 bringing them to your living rooms and the
 *dreamers* 
 creating what’s next…
 









 From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.
 








 The Senior Manager, Record to Report for Controllership will provide end\-to\-end leadership for the Record\-to\-Report accounting and controllership activities. This role will be based in Hyderabad and will be responsible for leading a large controllership team, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting, strong balance sheet governance, effective internal controls, and successful delivery of close, reporting, audit support, and compliance requirements.
   

 This is a critical leadership role within the Accounting COE and will play a key part in building, transitioning, stabilizing, and scaling controllership activities including transition from other regions. The Director will partner closely with Controllership, FP\&A, Tax, Treasury, Global Business Services (GBS), and other global and regional stakeholders to deliver high\-quality financial outcomes at scale.
   

 The role requires a strong controllership mindset, deep technical accounting knowledge, proven people leadership, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed, global environment. The successful candidate will be expected to lead transition of accounting work to WBD’s Hyderabad center, drive operational discipline, process standardization, automation, continuous improvement, and a culture of accountability, quality, and compliance.
   

 This role will manage \~ 2 Manager level accounting positions in Hyderabad and will oversee a broader team of \~10 accounting positions, supporting the controllership function. Your normal hours of work are 3:00 p.m IST. to 11:00 p.m IST. Monday to Friday. However, due to business needs, you may be required to work outside these hours and on holidays for the proper performance of your role without any additional pay. Subject to any applicable laws, the Company reserves the right to change your hours of work where this is essential to business needs and upon reasonable notice to you
   

 Your Role Accountabilities…
   

 Controllership, Close and Reporting Leadership
   

 • Lead and oversee RTR accounting and controllership activities
   

 • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, ensuring accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and compliance with applicable accounting and reporting requirements.
   

 • Supervise intercompany reconciliations and resolve out\-of\-balance items with WBD counterparts.
   

 • Ensure strong balance sheet governance, account reconciliation quality, variance analysis, management reporting, and timely issue resolution.
   

 • Review and analyze financial results against expectations and provide meaningful insights to controllership and business stakeholders.
   

 • Review and sign\-off monthly and quarterly Balance Sheets, Income Statements, and Cash Flow Statements, including footnotes disclosures and supplemental schedules, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
   

 • Ensure accounting implications of business transactions are assessed timely, including coordination with Technical Accounting teams where required.
   

 • Responsible for system/manual reconciliations between the Business Unit boundary systems and SAP, ensuring data consistency and accuracy
   

 • Continuously identify, design, and implement process improvements and standardizations across areas of responsibility to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. This includes special projects and serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) as needed.
   

 Governance, Controls and Audit Readiness
   

 • Maintain a strong internal control environment and ensure compliance with SOX requirements.
   

 • Partner with internal and external auditors to support audit planning, walkthroughs, testing, information requests, and timely closure of audit matters.
   

 • Drive discipline around documentation, evidence retention, review controls, issue tracking, and remediation.
   

 • Proactively identify financial reporting, compliance, and control risks and ensure appropriate escalation and resolution.
   

 Transition and Operating Model Buildout
   

 • Lead the transition, stabilization, and scaling of accounting activities being insourced from other regions into the Hyderabad Accounting COE.
   

 • Establish clear ownership, process documentation, KPIs, service levels, governance routines, and escalation mechanisms.
   

 • Partner with global and regional stakeholders to ensure business continuity, knowledge transfer, and successful transition outcomes.
   

 • Build sustainable team capacity and capability to support the future\-state controllership operating model.
   

 Stakeholder Management and Business Partnership
   

 • Act as the key connection point between the Hyderabad Accounting COE and Controllership, FP\&A, Tax, Treasury, GBS, and other business stakeholders.
   

 • Develop strong relationships with global and regional finance leaders and provide responsive, practical, and technically sound accounting support.
   

 • Collaborate with leadership to set department priorities and assist in problem resolution
   

 • Understand the business model and operating drivers to provide informed controllership advice and support decision\-making.
   

 • Ensure effective communication of accounting decisions, process impacts, deadlines, and risks across relevant stakeholder groups.
   

 Transformation, Process Excellence and Systems
   

 • Drive process standardization, simplification, automation, and continuous improvement across RTR activities.
   

 • Identify opportunities to improve close efficiency, reporting quality, control effectiveness, and team productivity.
   

 • Support system implementations, ERP\-related changes, integrations, reorganizations, and other finance transformation initiatives.
   

 • Lead process improvement initiatives in partnership with controllership, technology, GBS, and transformation teams.
   

 People Leadership and Talent Development
   

 • Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team of Senior Managers and accounting professionals.
   

 • Set clear goals, performance expectations, priorities, and accountability standards.
   

 • Build strong succession depth and develop controllership capability within the Hyderabad COE.
   

 • Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, integrity, continuous improvement, and high\-quality execution.
   

 • Assess workload, resource requirements, and capacity needs, and recommend changes as required.
   

 Qualifications \& Experience…
   

 Required
   

 ● Chartered Accountant, CPA, or equivalent professional accounting qualifications.
   

 ● 15\+ years of progressive accounting, controllership, financial reporting , with at least 5 years of supervisory role.
   

 ● Strong experience in RTR, close, balance sheet governance, financial reporting, audit support, and internal controls.
   

 • Deep understanding of US GAAP, and SOX control requirements, including intercompany and foreign currency accounting.
   

 ● Proven experience leading large accounting teams, including leaders/managers.
   

 ● Prior controllership experience in a multinational, matrixed, global organization.
   

 ● Strong stakeholder management experience with the ability to influence senior finance and business leaders.
   

 ● Demonstrated ability to operate in a fast\-paced environment, manage competing priorities, deliver against tight deadlines, and manage composure under deadline pressure.
   

 ● Strong analytical, problem\-solving, present solution, and decision\-making skills.
   

 ● Excellent written and verbal communication skills with high level transparency
   

 ● High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and commitment to quality and compliance.
   

 ● Able to work effectively across various time zones.
   

  

  

 Desired
   

 • Experience in media, entertainment, production, distribution, or related industries.
   

 • Experience with
 
 remote transition.
 

  


 • Experience with SAP or other large ERP platforms.
   

 • Experience leading finance transformation, automation, process standardization, or system implementation initiatives.
   

 • MBA or master’s degree in accounting, finance, or business preferred.
   

  

 Leadership Attributes
   

 • Strong controllership leader with sound judgment and high integrity.
   

 • Comfortable building structure in a changing environment.
   

 • Able to balance technical accounting depth with practical business partnership.
   

 • A leader who can build capability, coach teams, and create accountability.
   

 • A transformation\-minded leader who can simplify, standardize, and scale processes.
   

 • Confident working with senior stakeholders across regions and functions.
   

 • Proactive in identifying risks, resolving issues, and driving closure.
 















  


**How We Get Things Done…**









 This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at
 

















 www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/
 

















 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.
 








**Championing Inclusion at WBD**



 Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

title: Accounts Payable Manager
description:
**Role Overview** 




  





 A leading global organization is seeking a Manager, Accounts Payable to oversee end\-to\-end payables operations across multiple legal entities. Reporting to the Finance Controller, this role leads a team of AP specialists, acts as the primary liaison between Finance, Procurement, and external vendors, and drives automation, process standardization, and strong internal controls — all in alignment with US GAAP and company policies.
 



 This is a great opportunity for an experienced AP leader who wants to shape a high\-performing team, modernize the P2P process, and partner across the business in a fast\-paced, multi\-entity environment.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




  





**Team Leadership \& Development** 



* Build, mentor, and manage a team of AP Specialists and Senior Associates — setting clear KPIs, conducting regular reviews, and enabling continuous skill development
* Allocate workloads effectively to ensure metric adherence across invoice processing, vendor master maintenance, payment runs, T\&E expense management, and period\-end close.



  





**Invoice \& Payment Processing** 



* Oversee the end\-to\-end Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) cycle including PO creation and approval monitoring, 2\-way/3\-way matching (PO–Invoice–Receipt), invoice processing with business\-level approval, and payment execution via banking platform
* Ensure accurate and timely processing of vendor invoices across multiple business units; monitor AP aging to maintain optimal DPO
* Review and approve high\-value payment batches; manage escalation of exceptions and discrepancies in coordination with Procurement and business stakeholders
* Monitor and maintain direct debit payment tracking
* Oversee employee expense reimbursements in compliance with company policies.



  





**Month\-End Close \& Reporting** 



* Lead AP month\-end and year\-end close — ensure all invoices are posted, accruals are raised for open POs and uninvoiced services, and AP accounts are reconciled to the GL
* Prepare and review AP sub\-ledger aging reports, vendor reconciliation statements, and balance sheet schedules; present variance analyses and KPI dashboards to the Finance Controller
* Coordinate with the GL/Reporting team to ensure AP transactions are correctly reflected in financial statements in line with US GAAP and company accounting policies.



  





**Vendor \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Maintain strong working relationships with key vendors and business stakeholders to promptly resolve payment disputes, debit balances, and aged credits
* Collaborate closely with Procurement to streamline the P2P process, onboard new vendors, and maintain accurate vendor master data
* Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors on AP\-related queries, providing schedules and reconciliations as required.



  





**Systems, Automation \& Process Improvement** 



* Leverage ERP platforms (NetSuite, Oracle, Dayforce, SAP, or MS Dynamics) and travel management platforms (Concur, Navan) to drive automation of invoice capture, approval workflows, and payment processing
* Identify and champion process improvement initiatives — reducing manual touchpoints, improving straight\-through processing (STP) rates, and implementing e\-invoicing solutions
* Support Finance and ERP upgrades, system migrations, and integration of new entities or business units into the AP platform
* Define and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Risk and Control Matrix (RACM), and Delegation of Authority (DoA) for all AP processes; ensure SOX controls are operating effectively.



  





**Decision\-Making \& Scope** 



* Approve vendor payments within defined Delegation of Authority (DoA) limits
* Partner with Procurement on vendor onboarding, PO lifecycle management, and exception handling
* Collaborate with Finance\-IT and ERP teams on system enhancements, integrations, and upgrades
* Engage with external auditors and tax authorities to resolve queries and provide audit support



  





**What You’ll Bring** 




  




* B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance); CA Inter or CMA Inter is a strong plus
* 7–10 years of progressive Finance \& Accounting experience; minimum 3 years in a supervisory AP or P2P role
* Hands\-on experience managing end\-to\-end AP operations including invoice processing, payment runs, and period\-close activities
* Proficiency in at least one major ERP — NetSuite, SAP, Oracle Financials, Dayforce, or MS Dynamics
* Advanced Microsoft Excel — pivot tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, Power Query; Power BI or similar reporting tools a plus
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills; able to engage effectively with senior stakeholders, vendors, and global counterparts
* Demonstrated analytical and problem\-solving skills; ability to identify root causes and implement lasting process fixes
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines in a fast\-paced environment



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Experience working in a Global Business Services / Shared Services environment supporting global clients
* Exposure to multi\-currency transactions, intercompany AP settlements, and foreign vendor payments
* Prior experience with SAP Concur or similar travel \& expense / procurement platforms
* Familiarity with AP automation tools (Coupa, Ariba)
* Experience using Claude or similar AI platforms for automation initiatives
* Experience in the pharmaceutical, life sciences, or technology sector



  





 Please note that this is a confidential search. We kindly ask that all candidates keep details of this opportunity and any related conversations private throughout the recruitment process.

title: Capacity Planner
description:
We are looking for an experienced and analytical
 **Capacity Planner** 
 to oversee workforce planning, forecasting, scheduling, and resource management functions. The ideal candidate will have strong Workforce Management (WFM) experience, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to optimize staffing levels, ensure accurate forecasting, and manage real\-time operations to meet service level agreements (SLAs) and operational goals.
 



 The role involves working closely with leadership and cross\-functional teams to analyze performance metrics, mitigate staffing risks, and drive continuous improvement across team operations.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Capacity Planning \& Forecasting** 



* Develop accurate short\-term and long\-term volume forecasts and staffing models based on historical trends, business growth projections, and operational requirements.
* Analyze call, chat, and ticket patterns to identify workload trends and optimize capacity planning across teams and shifts.
* Determine staffing requirements based on forecasted workload, service level targets, shrinkage, and operational KPIs.
* Identify potential staffing gaps, capacity risks, and resource constraints.
* Partner with business and operations leadership to align workforce plans with business objectives.



**2\. Scheduling \& Resource Allocation** 



* Create, maintain, and publish optimal staff schedules that balance business requirements, agent preferences, and statutory compliance.
* Manage shift trades, time\-off requests, overtime, and offline activities to ensure adequate operational coverage.
* Optimize resource allocation across teams, shifts, and operational queues.
* Ensure staffing plans support service level commitments and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate with Operations and HR teams to address scheduling and workforce requirements.



**3\. Real\-Time Management \& Operations** 



* Monitor intra\-day volume, staffing levels, and schedule adherence in real time.
* Execute timely staffing adjustments to mitigate unexpected volume spikes, outages, and operational disruptions.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for operational escalations related to staffing shortages, outage management, and SLA risks.
* Monitor real\-time performance against forecasted volumes and staffing plans.
* Recommend corrective actions to maintain service levels and operational continuity.
* Collaborate with Operations and leadership teams during critical staffing or service disruptions.



**4\. Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Build and present daily, weekly, and monthly workforce management reports.
* Track and analyze key workforce metrics, including:
* Shrinkage
* Occupancy
* SLA Compliance
* Utilization
* Schedule Adherence
* Staffing Variance
* Forecast Accuracy
* Identify root causes for SLA misses, staffing variances, and operational inefficiencies.
* Provide actionable recommendations to improve workforce efficiency and service delivery.
* Develop dashboards and reporting solutions to support operational and leadership decision\-making.
* Drive continuous improvement through data\-driven workforce analytics.



**5\. Stakeholder \& Team Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Operations, Workforce Management, HR, and senior leadership teams.
* Provide insights and recommendations to support staffing, scheduling, and capacity decisions.
* Communicate staffing risks, operational challenges, and performance trends to relevant stakeholders.
* Support workforce planning initiatives, process improvements, and operational transformation projects.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment between business demand and workforce availability.



**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Statistics, Supply Chain, Operations Management, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in Workforce Management (WFM), Capacity Planning, or Resource Planning.
* Minimum 2\+ years of experience in a supervisory or managerial capacity.
* Strong experience in workforce forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and real\-time management.
* Proficiency in WFM tools such as NICE IEX, Aspect, Teleopti, and Verint
* Experience working with CRM platforms and contact center operations.
* Strong analytical skills with expertise in Excel/Google Sheets, forecasting models, and data visualization tools.
* In\-depth understanding of contact center dynamics, staffing requirements, shrinkage, occupancy, and workforce KPIs.
* Strong knowledge of Erlang C models and their application in workforce planning.
* Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and cross\-functional leadership skills.



**Preferred Qualifications (Bonus Points)** 



* Experience with SQL, Python, or advanced reporting frameworks for automated workforce analytics.
* Experience developing automated dashboards and workforce reporting solutions.
* Certifications in Workforce Management, Project Management, or related fields, such as:
* PMP (Project Management Professional)
* COPC certification or relevant COPC experience
* Workforce Management certifications
* Experience in large\-scale contact center operations or multi\-team workforce planning.
* Exposure to advanced forecasting, scenario modeling, and workforce optimization techniques.



**Personal Skills** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent planning, organizational, and time management abilities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage operational escalations.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in forecasting and reporting.
* Proactive approach to identifying staffing risks and operational challenges.
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams and leadership.
* Strong decision\-making skills with a data\-driven mindset.
* Adaptability to changing business requirements and operational priorities.
* Commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.



**Why Join Us?** 



* Opportunity to lead workforce planning and capacity optimization initiatives.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams and senior leadership.
* Drive operational efficiency through data\-driven decision\-making.
* Exposure to advanced workforce management tools, analytics, and automation.
* Contribute to continuous improvement and service delivery excellence.



**Apply Now** 




 If you are an experienced Workforce Management professional with strong forecasting, scheduling, and capacity planning expertise, we invite you to apply for the Capacity Planner role in Hyderabad and become part of our growing team.

 Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As a
 **Senior Associate, Membership – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN)** 
 , you will support the execution of U.S. pharmaceutical Membership operations by managing customer eligibility, GPO alignments, membership validations, customer setup, contract alignment, and membership maintenance activities. You will serve as a critical link between Market Access, Contracting, Pricing, Chargebacks, MDM, Government Pricing, wholesalers, GPOs, and customers to ensure accurate customer eligibility and contract execution across the Amgen commercial contracting landscape. The role supports the end\-to\-end Membership process from receipt of customer requests through validation, setup, system alignment, and ongoing maintenance.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
*Membership Operations \& Customer Eligibility*
* Support the end\-to\-end membership process including customer onboarding, eligibility validation, membership maintenance, GPO alignments, and customer relationship updates.
* Review and triage incoming membership requests received through the Membership mailbox from GPOs, wholesalers, Key Account Managers (KAMs), Contracting teams, and other stakeholders.
* Validate customer information submitted through Declaration (DEC) Forms, rosters, and customer requests to ensure completeness and compliance with contractual requirements.
* Determine customer eligibility based on contract terms, class of trade (COT), GPO participation, and business\-specific membership requirements.
* Support execution against established service level agreements (SLAs) and communicate status updates or delays to stakeholders as needed.


*Customer Validation \& Membership Maintenance*
* Perform customer validation activities utilizing HIN, DEA, HIBCC, HRSA, OneKey, HCM, GCPS, and other approved reference sources.
* Review Declaration (DEC) Forms for accuracy, completeness, valid signatures, proper customer identifiers, and current forms before processing.
* Validate parent\-child relationships, legal entity hierarchies (LEH), customer attributes, and customer master data prior to customer setup.
* Maintain membership records, customer alignments, contract affiliations, and GPO relationships within approved systems.
* Support customer adds, drops, strategy realignments, and membership updates resulting from acquisitions, organizational changes, roster updates, and contract transitions.


*Customer Setup \& Systems Management*
* Create and maintain customer records within HCM, GCPS, SAP, and related systems supporting commercial contract operations.
* Support customer onboarding activities including customer setup, LEH creation, customer attribute maintenance, and contract alignment.
* Coordinate with MDM teams to support customer record creation, updates, master data corrections, and hierarchy management.
* Monitor and validate system interfaces between HCM, SAP, GCPS, and related applications to ensure successful data synchronization.
* Investigate and resolve customer setup, interface, and data integrity issues impacting contract eligibility and pricing access.


*Membership Reporting \& Eligibility Management*
* Develop, validate, and distribute eligibility reports supporting GPOs, wholesalers, Market Access teams, and other stakeholders.
* Perform ongoing review of dispute reports and customer listings to identify missing, misaligned, or new customers requiring setup or updates.
* Support customer eligibility validations related to contract participation, GPO membership, specialty pharmacy programs, hospital coalitions, and other business\-specific arrangements
* Analyze membership trends, customer changes, roster updates, and operational metrics to support business decisions and improve data quality.


*Rebuttals, Dispute Resolution \& Stakeholder Support*
* Investigate customer eligibility disputes and support rebuttal activities with GPOs and external stakeholders.
* Review denial requests, perform customer eligibility research, prepare supporting rationale, and maintain appropriate documentation of decisions.
* Collaborate with Membership leadership, Contracting, Pricing, Chargebacks, Government Pricing, and external customers to resolve membership\-related inquiries and issues.
* Maintain complete documentation and audit trails supporting membership decisions, customer alignments, and eligibility determinations.


*PHS, 340B \& Specialized Membership Programs*
* Support quarterly Public Health Service (PHS) and 340B eligibility updates, customer validation activities, and contract maintenance processes.
* Review OPA extracts and support additions, removals, and maintenance of 340B eligibility indicators and customer attributes
* Support hospital coalition pricing reviews, validation of coalition participation, and eligibility assessments.
* Assist with specialty pharmacy, Kaiser, IBU, OBU, Tezspire, and other membership program\-specific processes and customer validations.


*Compliance, Controls \& Audit Readiness*
* Ensure compliance with SOX controls, internal policies, pricing governance requirements, audit standards, and applicable pharmaceutical contracting regulations


*Compliance, Controls \& Continuous Improvement*
* Execute work in accordance with SOX controls, internal policies, pricing governance requirements, audit standards, and pharmaceutical contracting expectations.
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation supporting customer setup, eligibility reviews, approvals, and membership updates.
* Support audit requests, control testing, operational reviews, and compliance activities.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, improve data quality, reduce cycle times, and enhance customer setup efficiency.
* Participate in UAT, system enhancements, reporting improvements, and process optimization initiatives.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a detail\-oriented commercial operations professional with experience supporting customer master data, membership operations, customer eligibility, contract administration, pricing operations, or related pharmaceutical business processes. This individual should bring strong analytical skills, customer focus, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset to ensure accurate and compliant membership execution.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in business administration, Finance, Commerce, Economics, Life Sciences, Healthcare Administration, or related discipline.
* 3–6 years of experience in pharmaceutical commercial operations, membership operations, contracts \& pricing, customer master data, managed markets, market access, revenue management, or related business functions
* Experience supporting customer validation, contract administration, data management, reporting, or operational processes.
* Strong Excel, analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a deadline\-driven environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry experience.
* Knowledge of U.S. pharmaceutical customer eligibility, membership operations, GPO contracting, market access, and reimbursement processes.
* Experience with HCM, GCPS, SAP, Tableau, OneKey, HIBCC, HRSA, Model N, or similar commercial operations platforms.
* Understanding of customer master data management, legal entity hierarchies, parent\-child relationships, class of trade management, and contract eligibility processes.
* Experience supporting customer onboarding, data governance, compliance controls, and audit activities.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience collaborating with U.S.\-based stakeholders in a global operating model.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Staff**
**Description**
 EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker\-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process \& controls.
   

  

 Within EY’s Risk Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset\-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As part of the financial analysis of the bank’s exposures to a diverse range of public, semi‑public, and private counterparties \- including local authorities and their affiliates, public institutions, sovereigns, public financial institutions, SPVs, corporates, PPP/concession companies, and sponsors \- analysts will support credit‑risk assessments and contribute to internal‑rating activities across France and key international markets (primarily France, Italy, Spain, the UK, and, to a lesser extent, the US).
   

  

**Core Responsibilities:**
* Support the collection, quality review, and analysis of financial statements and key risk data for relevant counterparties.
* Assist in the preparation, structuring, and validation of input files and data flows used in rating processes and engines.
* Contribute to the drafting of financial analysis reports / credit memos, including key drivers, risks/mitigants, and preliminary views on ratings/outlooks, under supervision.
* Perform controls and reconciliations to ensure data quality, completeness, and consistency prior to processing.
* For French public sector entities, support data preprocessing and preparation of inputs for mass processing in the rating engine (as applicable).
* Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to support day\-to\-day operations and contribute to process improvements and documentation updates.
* Build, review, and validate financial models with strong command of Excel;
* Analyze large datasets and generate comparative insights (experience with Power BI/SQL is an advantage).


**Domain Skills Required:**
* Conduct in‑depth financial analysis, including detailed review of public‑sector and corporate financial statements (IFRS/French GAAP), ratio assessments (leverage, coverage, liquidity), evaluation of working capital requirements, and comprehensive cash‑flow analysis.
* Apply project‑finance principles to assess SPV cash‑flow structures, DSCR/LLCR metrics, debt‑sizing considerations, covenant frameworks, reserve mechanisms, security packages, and risk‑allocation structures across concession and PPP projects.
* Evaluate sovereign and quasi‑sovereign credit risk by analyzing institutional frameworks, governance quality, policy stability, and levels of explicit or implicit government support.
* Perform corporate and sectoral assessments by analyzing business models, industry dynamics, competitive positioning (utilities, transportation, energy, social infrastructure), and conducting sensitivity and benchmarking analyses across markets.
* Review and interpret financing documentation, including term sheets, loan documentation, covenant packages, guarantees, and where applicable key provisions within bond indentures.
* Prepare clear, structured, and analytically sound credit memoranda, including rating recommendations, risk/mitigation assessments, and identification of early‑warning indicators.
* Support and conduct gap assessments, impact analyses, and business‑readiness evaluations related to regulatory change initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong technical expertise and up‑to‑date industry knowledge across financial products, market practices, and risk methodologies.
* Lead key workstreams within large‑scale client engagements or independently manage smaller engagements, ensuring consistent delivery of high‑quality outcomes.
* Review outputs prepared by team members to ensure analytical quality, completeness, and adherence to internal standards.
* Stay informed of emerging trends, regulatory changes, and sector‑specific developments to anticipate client needs and strengthen advisory delivery.
* Monitor project progress, proactively manage risks, and communicate priorities, challenges, and updates effectively to stakeholders.
* Mentor and guide junior consultants, fostering skill development, knowledge sharing, and professional growth within the team.


**Qualifications, Certifications And Education**
**Must\-have:**
* Master’s degree in Business Administration (Finance/Economics) or CA qualification, with 1\-4 years of relevant experience in financial analysis or risk‑related roles.
* Foundational experience (internship/apprenticeship/junior role) in financial analysis, credit risk, audit, or corporate finance.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, core credit risk principles, and familiarity with project finance, corporate, or sovereign risk concepts.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, with foundational knowledge of Power BI and/or SQL considered a plus.
* Working knowledge of Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance, and Financial Reporting frameworks.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business and technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Demonstrated automation and innovation mindset, with willingness to improve processes and tools.
* Strong command of written and spoken professional English.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly.


**Good\-to\-have:**
* Professional certifications such as FRM, CFA, or PRM.
* Regulatory exposure or experience in areas such as Credit Underwriting, Basel frameworks, and CCAR.
* Familiarity with risk‑management systems, tools, or platforms.
* Willingness to travel based on client or project requirements.
* Previous project management experience
* Proficiency in French is highly advantageous and may be required for certain engagements.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
 **Good Health Can’t Wait**

 We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency
   

  





 Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. **Job Description**

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team responsible for trade claims management.

**4\. Reporting \& Analytics**



* Deliver periodic reports on claim status, KPIs tracking, deviations management
* Provide analytics to support to commercial teams on customer/market wise information to make quicker decisions.



**5\. Cross‑Functional Collaboration**



* Partner closely with Sales, Trade Marketing, Key Accounts, and Finance teams for scheme setup, claim resolution, etc.
* Support business teams with relevant insights and process guidance. Work with Sales Finance to align on trade budgets, accruals, and forecasted spends.

 CA, CMA, \& MBA with relevant industry experience

 **FMCG/Consumer Goods/Retail** 
 trade promotions, sales finance, commercial finance, or claims management.

 **SAP SD/FI** 
 and

 (TCM module).

* Strong understanding of Consumer healthcare/FMCG various trade structures and scheme mechanics.

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* High attention to detail, problem‑solving ability, and process orientation.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
**Company Description** 
 Finance Box Private Limited is a technology\-driven financial services company focused on delivering seamless, automated solutions without the need for human intervention. The organization is committed to transforming how individuals and businesses access financial services by leveraging advanced digital platforms. With a strong emphasis on innovation, Finance Box aims to integrate artificial intelligence into core finance operations to improve accuracy, speed, and user experience. Team members join a forward\-looking environment that values efficiency, data\-driven decision\-making, and continuous improvement in financial technology.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Senior Accountant role at Finance Box Private Limited is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Hyderabad. This role involves managing end\-to\-end accounting functions, including general ledger maintenance, accounts payable and receivable, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities. The Senior Accountant will prepare and review financial statements, ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards and tax regulations, and support internal and external audits. Daily responsibilities also include monitoring financial transactions, reconciling accounts, analyzing variances, and providing insights to support budgeting and forecasting. The role collaborates closely with finance and operations teams to ensure accurate reporting and to contribute to process automation and efficiency improvements aligned with the company’s technology\-driven approach.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong proficiency in core accounting practices, including general ledger accounting, account reconciliation, and financial statement preparation.
* Experience with financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis to support strategic decision\-making.
* Knowledge of local tax regulations, compliance requirements, and audit processes, with the ability to work effectively with auditors and regulatory bodies.
* Hands\-on experience with accounting software and ERP systems, and comfort working with technology\-driven financial tools and automation.
* Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and data analysis, with attention to detail and accuracy in numerical work.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present financial information clearly to non\-finance stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field;
* Prior experience in a senior accounting or lead accounting role, preferably within a technology\-driven or financial services organization.
* Commitment to ethical financial practices and continuous learning, including openness to working with AI\-based and automated finance solutions.

title: Senior Accounting Analyst- Closing & Reporting- A2R
description:
**Job title: A2R CR Sr. Accounting Analyst**
* Location: Hyderabad


**About The Job**
 Sanofi Business Services (SBS), one of the 4 pillars of Sanofi’s Business Transformation organization, is setting up a captive Business Services center in Hyderabad to provide Finance \& Accounting (Account\-to\-Report, Customer\-Invoicing\-to\-Cash) as well as Employee oriented (Employee Experience) services. With respect to Account to Report (A2R) the Business Services center will be covering the following areas of the process:
   

  

* Assets Management
* Intercompany Accounting
* Treasury Accounting
* GL Accounts Closing and Reporting


 The Closing \& Reporting Accountant reports to A2R Closing \& Reporting Lead and works closely with Finance (Controlling, Treasury, Internal Control), other SBS departments, Customer Service and the A2R team.
   

  

 Our Hubs are a crucial part of how we innovate, improving performance across every Sanofi department and providing a springboard for the amazing work we do. Build a career and you can be part of transforming our business while helping to change millions of lives. Ready? As a C\&R Sr. Accounting Analyst within our Account to Report, you’ll be working in line to Increase automation, Optimize process, Centralize master data \& Build a robust Governance.
   

  

 We are an innovative global healthcare company with one purpose: to chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We’re also a company where you can flourish and grow your career, with countless opportunities to explore, make connections with people, and stretch the limits of what you thought was possible. Ready to get started?
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Operation: Deliver GL monthly closing \& reporting services to SBS. Review interfaces that generate automatic postings to ensure that they have been correctly booked and close Balance Sheet and P\&L accounts. Request \& collect all recurring and non\-recurring items, reconcile accounts and post Manual Journal Entries (MJE). Prepare ad\-hoc reports and analysis.
* Contribute to business reviews. Execute in compliance of processes, transactions and reports with Sanofi accounting policies, internal control guidelines and audit / SOX requirements.
* Complete all activities as per the global Core Model and operational KPIs. Develop expert level knowledge of the activities in scope as well as local knowledge of entities in scope and become a super\-user.
* Pro\-actively anticipate operational issues and coach junior analysts. Build, document and transfer A2R Core Model process knowledge (Level 6/7\) relating to GL monthly closure and reporting activities.
* Continuous improvement: Identify process improvement opportunities through elimination of redundant activities. Participate in process automation initiatives and ensure seamless adoption and transition.


**About You**
* Education \& Experience: Graduate degree in accounting or finance/ Professional Qualification like CA/ACCA/CPA (preferred). Good and proven experience of 4\-8 years/ 1\-2 Yrs (for CA/ACCA/CPA) in GL accounting preferably in an international multicultural environment (essential). Fluent in English (essential), Knowledge of other European languages (advantageous)
* Functional: Knowledge of IFRS and local GAAPs (essential). Hands on expertise in GL accounting, closing \& reporting processes, and activities (essential). Knowledge of GL accounting and reporting (essential). Experience in working within a Business Services organization (advantageous). Good business acumen (advantageous). Strong problem solving, deductive and analytical skills (advantageous)
* Technical: Hands\-on experience of SAP FICO – End user (essential) and other accounting related IT tools (e.g. Trintech Cadency, Blackline) (advantageous). Knowledge of Microsoft Office and expertise of MS Excel (essential)
* Interpersonal: Ability to interact with internal and external clients in a professional manner (essential). Team player, able to work collaboratively transversally and with A2R front line teams with an end\-to\-end mindset (essential). Good communication skills (advantageous). Attentive to customer needs and feedback (advantageous).
* Leadership: Ability to organize, prioritize and structure the tasks for oneself (essential). Attentive to detail and works with precision (advantageous). Action oriented, delivery driven, change agent (advantageous). Role model / coach to junior analysts (advantageous)
* Working Hours: Be responsible for the period\-end closing and reporting in accordance with Sanofi month end close schedule. The associate may need to work in different working hours during the month\-end closing period for 5\-7 days, depending on the region they support.


**Why choose us?**
 Add four standard Sanofi selling points and up to three additional selling points that are specific to the role, team or location.
   

  

* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future\-focused team.
* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
* Enjoy a thoughtful, well\-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
* Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high\-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender\-neutral parental leave.
* Part of Global Finance services in Sanofi, gives a great opportunity to work and have a enriching experience in Account to Report domain area.
* Opportunity to also have a Global exposure in accounting and experience on working for multiple geographies.

TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full\-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.

**Position Summary**
 The Senior Manager leads the AIIC Inventory Accounting team and is accountable for the timely, accurate, and well\-controlled execution of inventory accounting activities supporting the financial close and external reporting processes. The role oversees journal entries, account reconciliations, inventory analyses, internal controls, audit support, process documentation, and issue resolution.
   

  

 As a senior leader within AIIC Controllership team, the Senior Manager partners with U.S. Inventory Accounting leadership and cross\-functional teams, including Asset Protection, Supply Chain, Merchandising, Finance, Audit, and Technology. The role may also support other AIIC accounting processes, provide leadership coverage within Controllership, and help transition additional accounting activities from the United States to India.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and develop the AIIC Inventory Accounting team, establish clear priorities, and ensure high\-quality, timely delivery.
* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities, including journal entries, account reconciliations, inventory analyses, and management reporting.
* Review inventory balances, valuation, shrink, reserves, obsolescence, and related accounting matters; investigate and resolve significant variances and reconciling items.
* Ensure inventory accounting complies with U.S. GAAP, company policies, and established close and documentation standards.
* Partner with U.S. Inventory Accounting leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders to resolve accounting, data, process, and control issues.
* Support the design, implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of financial and operational controls.
* Lead targeted risk and control assessments and recommend practical control enhancements across business, financial, and technology processes.
* Maintain SOX documentation, including process narratives, flowcharts, risk and control matrices, testing support, and control evidence.
* Coordinate internal and external audit requests and ensure complete, accurate, and timely responses.
* Develop and maintain accounting policies, standard operating procedures, process flows, and supporting documentation.
* Lead process improvement and automation initiatives that improve accuracy, efficiency, scalability, and transparency.
* Design and monitor key reports and performance measures used to execute controls and manage accounting processes.
* Lead knowledge transfer, training, and process transitions between U.S. and India teams.
* Provide clear updates on risks, issues, projects, and results to Controllership and business leadership.
* Demonstrate sound judgment, integrity, and accountability in all activities.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing accounting professionals.
* Experience managing monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close activities.
* Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, general ledger accounting, journal entries, account reconciliations, financial analysis, and internal controls.
* Experience with inventory accounting matters such as valuation, shrink, obsolescence, reserves, standard costing, landed cost, or related areas.
* Experience supporting SOX compliance and internal or external audits.
* Experience in a public company, shared service center, global capability center, multinational organization, or similarly matrixed environment.
* Strong analytical, organizational, problem\-solving, and project management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication, facilitation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver accurate results within deadlines.
* High level of initiative, professional judgment, ethics, and integrity.
* Professional accounting qualification, such as Chartered Accountant, Certified Public Accountant, or Cost and Management Accountant, preferred.
* Experience with Oracle, BlackLine, and AS400 preferred.
* Retail, distribution, consumer products, automotive aftermarket, or other high\-volume inventory experience preferred.


 Education and Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

 As the Associate, Channel Operations – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN), you will support execution of U.S. Channel operations within the Contracts \& Pricing Execution function. The Associate will be expected to learn Channel processes through structured KT, shadowing, reverse shadowing, and supervised execution prior to taking on broader independent responsibilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
*Channel Operations \& Execution*
* Support day\-to\-day execution of Channel operations including CDP updates, GCPS maintenance, payment package preparation, scorecard generation, tracker maintenance, reporting support, and documentation management.
* Execute assigned standard\-state Channel activities in accordance with SOPs, desktop procedures, validation checklists, quality standards, and established timelines.
* Maintain accurate trackers for contract updates, CDP changes, scorecard status, waiver activity, payment readiness, reconciliations, open items, and evidence retention.
* Escalate risks, missing information, data anomalies, access issues, late amendments, waiver concerns, or processing exceptions to the Channel Manager and retained ATO owners.


*CDP \& GCPS Support*
* Support Conga review activities, contract amendment tracking, Monthly and Quarterly CDP Update preparation, and maintenance of supporting documentation.
* Perform standard CDP maintenance activities and support GCPS setup and configuration updates for approved contract, pricing, fee, rebate, strategy, and program changes.
* Assist with CDP\-to\-GCPS validation, peer review support, discrepancy documentation, and issue resolution tracking.
* Maintain supporting files including master files, strategy trackers, product updates, waiver trackers, and contract\-related documentation.


*Scorecards, Validation \& Payment Support*
* Generate and maintain scorecards using approved master files, DOH inputs, net sales data, and contractual parameters.
* Perform first\-pass validation of scorecards, payment calculations, performance reports, reconciliations, and supporting reporting outputs.
* Support payment package preparation, payment tracker updates, variance research, documentation preparation, and approval package readiness.
* Investigate standard discrepancies and coordinate supporting data collection for manager review.


*Analytics, Reconciliation \& Reporting*
* Support net sales reconciliation activities across SAP, GCPS, IntegriChain, and related reporting sources.
* Perform recurring DOH calculations, direct sales validation, 852/867 review support, variance analysis, and compliance reporting activities.
* Assist with trend reporting, scorecard reporting, performance reporting, payment package support, and routine operational dashboards.
* Maintain audit\-ready supporting workpapers and reconciliation documentation.


*Product Launch \& Master Data Support*
* Support routine product launch tracking activities, MMDS documentation updates, master data coordination, and approved pricing update activities.
* Assist with price list maintenance, documentation readiness, product setup tracking, and launch\-related reporting.
* Maintain launch documentation, approvals, and supporting records in accordance with SOP requirements.


*Compliance, Controls \& Audit Readiness*
* Execute work in accordance with Channel SOPs, SOX controls, documentation requirements, and compliance expectations.
* Maintain audit\-ready evidence supporting validations, reconciliations, payment activities, approvals, and operational controls.
* Support internal audits, SOX reviews, KT activities, documentation updates, and process compliance reviews.
* Escalate data integrity, compliance, operational, or financial risks promptly and support remediation efforts.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a detail\-oriented operations professional with strong analytical, documentation, reconciliation, and process execution capabilities. This individual should demonstrate ownership, accuracy, continuous learning, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset while supporting a highly controlled Channel operations environment.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or master’s degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, Analytics, or related discipline.
* 2 to 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, finance operations, Channel operations, managed markets, revenue management, analytics, contracting operations, or related business operations.
* Strong Excel, reporting, documentation, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, follow SOPs, and work effectively in a controlled operational environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to Channel Payments, distributor agreements, fee and rebate administration, Gross\-to\-Net operations, contract operations, or pharmaceutical commercial operations.
* Experience with Model N GCPS, SAP, Conga, IntegriChain, SharePoint, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, Power Automate, or similar business systems.
* Understanding of DOH calculations, scorecards, reconciliations, payment validation, contract amendments, compliance reporting, and operational controls.
* Experience supporting SOP development, issue tracking, audit support, testing, process documentation, automation, or continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong communication, collaboration, attention\-to\-detail, and stakeholder management skills in a global operating model.

title: Value & Access Insights Mgr
description:
**About Amgen**
