We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Role Description:
   

  

 In the face of a US health care system growing more complex day\-by\-day, we must constantly adapt and evolve our strategies to ensure our patients have appropriate access to our medicines. The US Value \& Access (V\&A) Insights Manager will play a critical role in monitoring, diagnosing, and addressing payer obstacles and challenges.
   

  

 The Value and Access Manager is responsible for analytics relating to managed care/organized customers and help shape payer \& copay strategies for Value \& Access Analytics insights organization . The Role will be part of a cross functional analytics insights team to provide integrated analyses and insights to US Market access and Patient access and reimbursement team. This role is specifically responsible for providing insights impacting payer reimbursement strategies through secondary data analytics and data integration
   

  

 This position will report to the Senior Manager, Value \& Access Insights team
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Lead the analytics for US Value \& Access rare disease Business unit
* Partner with US Coverage and Pricing, Contracting, Patient access \& Reimbursement and other Commercial teams to build and prioritize analytics and insights plans in support of value and access strategy for Amgen brands
* Provide in\-depth, expertise\-based oversight and delivery of managed markets analysis including product formulary position, utilization management controls, customer segmentation and control/sophistication assessment.
* Develop frameworks \& analytics to characterize the Rare Disease patient journey, including symptoms/diagnosis, referral pathways, treatment initiation, switching, discontinuation, and persistence Prepare, continuously refine and present periodic reports tracking product and portfolio performance against business objectives.
* Execute analytics plan to support payer insights from various payer datasets based on detailed understanding of related datasets i.e Patient level claims data; Payer claims data; Formulary coverage; Specialty Pharmacy Data.
* Oversee efforts of 1\-3 associates, including setting performance standards, managing their staffing, and monitoring performance
* Build and maintain strong relationships with cross functional partners; proactively seeks buy\-in and provide ongoing support to address business needs
* Lead the development of analytics models to generate strategic actionable business insights using SQL, Python and Microsoft Excel


**Basic Qualifications:**
* Master’s degree in computer science, statistics or STEM majors with a minimum of 5 years of Information Systems experience OR
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, statistics or STEM majors with a minimum of 7 years of Information Systems experience.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience with new product / indication launch especially in rare disease areas
* Prior working experience on Analytics of products with medical benefit and Pharmacy benefit usage
* Prior experience in contracts and pricing, direct payer experience or value marketing and have a good foundational understanding of the US payer environment and a strong foundation in the U.S. healthcare market
* Excellent conceptual problem\-solving skills with demonstrated ability to bring structure to vaguely defined problems, pragmatic problem\-solving approach, and manage execution
* Exceptional written/oral communication skills and executive presence across functions and across different levels of leadership
* Strong leadership skills with a demonstrated ability to influence different styles
* 5\+ years of healthcare experience in the biopharmaceutical industry, health care, and/or strategy consulting with specific experience and expertise in coverage, access and reimbursement drivers impacting the biopharmaceutical industry
* High degree of analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Exhibits strong understanding of business strategies
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
* Experience with Databricks platform for data analytics
* Proficiency in any one of the languages \- R, Python, SAS


 EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT
   

  

 Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: VP - Business Manager
description:
**Job Title: VP\- Business Manager**
 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected, and opinions count. We foster continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. As part of the Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function, you’ll play a vital role in supporting HSBC’s second line of defence, ensuring robust risk management and operational excellence across the Group.
   

  

 The Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function is HSBC’s Second Line of Defence, responsible for reviewing and challenging the activities of the Group’s businesses to ensure effective risk management. With a global headcount of \~14,000 and annual costs of \~$1\.5bn, R\&C is evolving its operating model, requiring robust oversight, administration, and management. This role is pivotal in supporting the R\&C CAO CoE, driving operational excellence, and enabling strategic objectives in a dynamic, highly scrutinized environment. The role holder needs to understand the impact of all these changes on Risk \& Compliance and HSBC and support the Global R\&C COO, Global R\&C CAO and Head CAO CoE as necessary. The role holder will be required to interact with many internal and external parties at the highest level of management and therefore needs an outstanding level of professionalism and gravitas. As a Senior Business Manager within the R\&C C oE, you will be a strategic partner to Lines of Business and Global R\&C Sub\-functions, helping leaders turn centrally produced financial, workforce and performance data into clear decisions and practical action. You will connect insight with business context, identify risks and opportunities, generate ideas to improve performance and help shape priorities across the function. Reporting to the R\&C Head of CAO CoE India, you will work with global, regional and business stakeholders to translate information into a compelling performance story, challenge assumptions and coordinate delivery. Financial analysis and tracking remain important; however, the core data and reporting are produced centrally. Your value will come from interpreting what the data means, asking the right questions and enabling timely, well\-informed choices.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine strong business judgement, curiosity and influencing skills with an understanding of risk management and organisational performance. They will be comfortable leading a team, navigating a global matrix and moving stakeholders from insight to action.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
 The role holder will share good practice globally, lead a team and build trusted relationships across the function. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Partner with the Global R\&C CAO wider team and senior leaders to understand priorities, performance and delivery challenges across assigned Lines of Business and Global Sub\-functions. Use centrally produced financial, workforce and performance information to build a clear view of what is changing, why it matters and where leadership action is required.
* Identify trends, risks, opportunities and emerging themes, connecting information across teams to generate ideas for improved performance, effectiveness and service delivery. Challenge assumptions and test whether plans, resources and investments remain aligned to business priorities.
* Use scenario analysis to explore choices, trade\-offs and potential outcomes for the relevant Sub\-function or Line of Business.
* Support decisions on consultancy, third\-party spend, hiring and out\-of\-plan requirements by assessing business need, value and alignment to priorities. Track agreed actions and outcomes, helping leaders understand whether interventions are delivering the intended impact.
* Support senior leaders across Lines of Business and Sub\-functions with integrated business management covering performance, people, priorities, governance and organisational effectiveness. Create clear leadership narratives from centrally produced Management Information, focusing discussion on decisions, actions and opportunities rather than reporting alone.
* Coordinate business planning and governance rhythms, ensuring priorities, dependencies and actions remain visible and connected. Coordinate and execute the business change and organisational design activity required to deliver the agreed financial resource plan, across both cost and FTE
* Build trusted relationships with R\&C leadership and partners across the Global Businesses, Global Functions, Finance and HR. Facilitate constructive, evidence\-based conversations that help stakeholders align on priorities and make timely decisions.
* Bring together perspectives from global and regional stakeholders to spot themes, share learning and scale effective ideas. Provide constructive challenge to existing practices and proposed initiatives, developing practical solutions to complex issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve value, simplify activity and redirect resources to the areas of greatest strategic importance.
* Lead, coach and develop direct reports, creating clear priorities and promoting curiosity, collaboration and high\-quality delivery. Support effective performance, talent and succession management across the team


**To Be Successful You Will**
**Knowledge \& Qualifications**
* Strong understanding of business management, organisational performance and strategy execution.
* Ability to interpret financial, workforce and operational information and connect it to business context and decisions. Sound understanding of the external banking environment, including regulatory, political and competitive factors.
* Strong awareness of internal control, operational risk and the role of Risk \& Compliance.
* Awareness of data governance and the importance of reliable, consistent information for decision\-making. Demonstrated success in using business, financial, workforce or operational insight to influence senior decisions and improve outcomes. Experience turning complex data and competing viewpoints into clear narratives, options and recommendations.
* Proven ability to identify opportunities, generate practical ideas and lead performance or organisational improvement.
* Experience working with central Finance, HR or data teams and applying their outputs within a business context.
* Strong stakeholder management experience in a complex, global matrix organisation. Experience shaping and delivering people, capability or engagement plans across diverse teams.
* Experience coordinating and executing business change and organisational design activity to deliver cost and FTE plans. Strategic and commercial judgement, with the ability to connect insight to business priorities. Intellectual curiosity and confidence asking questions that uncover the story behind the data.
* Ability to spot patterns, risks and opportunities and develop practical ideas in response.
* Excellent communication, storytelling and influencing skills, including with senior stakeholders. Strong leadership, collaboration and facilitation skills.
* Comfort interpreting data and scenarios without needing to own the underlying financial production processes.
* Proactive, resilient and effective in a fast\-moving international environment. Outstanding organisational and problem management skills, and extensive project and programme management exposure


**hsbc.com/careers
   

  

 You’ll achieve more at HSBC**
 HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

title: Senior Risk Manager - Inspection, Finance Operations Risk, Governance, & Experience, Finance Operations Risk, Governance & Experience (FORGE)
description:
**Description**
 Amazon is seeking a Senior Risk Manager to support the Finance Operations (FinOps) Controllership team at Amazon. We’re looking for someone who can take lead in understanding complex FinOps processes and identify the full range of risks related to processes, regulatory compliance, organization, policy, and technology. This individual will ensure FinOps processes stay ahead of risks associated with process design, internal control effectiveness, computer system integration, and other relevant areas.
   

  

 As a Senior Risk Manager on the FORGE team, you won't just find problems—you'll architect solutions. You will lead high\-impact audits and risk programs across Finance Operations (FinOps), with a primary focus on Accounts Receivable and Payroll. Your work will directly strengthen the control environment, protect Amazon from material risk, and drive the kind of operational excellence that lets Finance scale with confidence.
   

  

 This isn't a role where you wait for direction. You'll operate in spaces where the problem isn't fully defined, where control gaps span multiple systems and teams, and where the right answer requires deep investigation, cross\-functional influence, and the courage to challenge the status quo. If you thrive on turning complexity into clarity—and ambiguity into action—this role was built for you.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Successful candidates must be eager to dive deep into processes and have a proven record of delivering meaningful risks and recommendations to the business. The candidate should have strong auditing skills, problem solving skills, systems and process knowledge, and a passion for customer service. Specific core responsibilities are below:
   

  

* Perform risk assessment of the services and functions in FinOps
* Perform end to end audits, including scoping, fieldwork, and reporting.
* Evaluate design and effectiveness of FinOps controls
* Evaluate policy and process exceptions
* Provide trainings that improve and raise the bar on controllership with respect to policies and other requirements

 A day in the life
   

  

* Lead scoping, planning, and execution of complex audits and risk assessments across FinOps processes.

* Identify control gaps, evaluate control effectiveness, and drive sustainable remediation plans.
* Define project objectives, success criteria, and risk reduction metrics.
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to prioritize risk initiatives, influence decisions, and drive execution.
* Develop data\-driven audit reports and executive communications presenting findings and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Influence stakeholders to implement scalable, automated controls and eliminate recurring risks.
* Leverage data, automation, and technology to improve risk detection and audit efficiency.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
* Experience in internal audit and risk management or equivalent

* Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion

title: Head – Trade Finance & Structured Finance
description:
**Trade Finance \& Debt Fundraising Manager** 




**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Experience:** 
 4–10 Years
 



**Department:** 
 Finance / Corporate Treasury
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Compensation:** 
 Based on Current CTC, Relevant Experience \& Interview Performance
 








**Role Purpose** 




 We are looking for an experienced Trade Finance \& Debt Fundraising Manager to take ownership of sourcing, structuring, negotiating, and securing trade finance, working capital, alternative debt, and other funding facilities for our import\-export and cross\-border trading business. The candidate will be responsible for developing relationships with international trade\-finance platforms, fintech lenders, NBFCs, institutional lenders, and private credit funds and converting these relationships into actual funding facilities and successful disbursements.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 ·      Research and map suitable alternative trade finance providers based on the company's trade corridors, buyers, suppliers, transaction structures, and funding requirements.
 



 ·      Identify and build relationships with trade\-finance platforms and lenders, including Drip Capital, Incomlend, Tradewind, Stenn, KredX, Velotrade, Demica, PrimaDollar, and other suitable international/domestic funding providers.
 



 ·      Evaluate financing products such as Invoice Factoring, Invoice Discounting, Receivables Financing, Receivables Discounting, Supply Chain Financing, Purchase Order Financing, Pre\-Shipment Finance, Post\-Shipment Finance, Trade Credit Facilities, and other alternative working\-capital solutions.
 



 ·      Identify financing options that offer collateral\-free, unsecured, or collateral\-light funding wherever commercially and legally feasible.
 



 ·      Initiate, develop, and manage relationships with trade\-finance companies, fintech lenders, NBFCs, institutional lenders, private credit funds, and alternative financing providers.
 



 ·      Present the company's business model, trade cycles, buyers, suppliers, financial position, and funding requirements to potential lenders and funding partners.
 



 ·      Prepare and submit complete funding applications and coordinate all documentation required by lenders and financing platforms.
 



 ·      Collect and coordinate trade documents, purchase orders, commercial invoices, export/import documents, buyer and supplier information, buyer/supplier credit history, financial statements, bank statements, KYC documents, corporate/legal documents, and other lender requirements.
 



 ·      Manage the complete lender due\-diligence process and coordinate responses to lender queries until approval, sanction, documentation, and disbursement.
 



 ·      Compare funding proposals across multiple providers based on advance rate, discount/interest rate, tenor, processing fees, arrangement fees, other charges, recourse vs. non\-recourse, collateral/security requirements, repayment structure, and overall cost of capital.
 



 ·      Negotiate with lenders and funding providers to obtain competitive interest/discount rates, higher advance rates, suitable tenors, lower fees, and favorable financing terms.
 



 ·      Structure appropriate debt and working\-capital facilities based on the company's trade cycles and funding requirements.
 



 ·      Explore and structure blended funding solutions, combining trade finance, trade credit lines, working\-capital debt, alternative debt, equity, venture debt, or other suitable funding sources where required.
 



 ·      Evaluate whether debt, equity, venture debt, or a combination of funding sources is most appropriate for a particular funding requirement.
 



 ·      Continuously identify new domestic and international funding sources to reduce dependency on traditional collateral\-based bank financing.
 



 ·      Liaise with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure that cross\-border financing structures comply with applicable FEMA, RBI regulations, RBI ECB Guidelines, OFAC/sanctions requirements, AML/KYC requirements, UCP 600, and other applicable regulatory requirements depending on the transaction and jurisdiction.
 



 ·      Maintain a detailed funding pipeline covering potential lenders, discussions, applications submitted, due diligence, approvals, sanctioned limits, documentation, disbursements, outstanding facilities, and upcoming funding requirements.
 



 ·      Monitor approved credit lines, utilization, outstanding amounts, repayment schedules, available limits, and future funding requirements.
 



 ·      Report regularly to the CFO / Senior Management on funding opportunities, lender discussions, approved and sanctioned credit lines, disbursements, funding pipeline, financing terms, and cost of capital.
 



 ·      Take complete ownership of funding transactions from lender identification → initial discussion → application → due diligence → negotiation → credit approval → documentation → sanction → successful disbursement.
 



**Required Skills and Background** 




 ·      4–10 years of relevant experience in Trade Finance, Export\-Import Banking, Corporate Treasury, Debt Fundraising, Alternative Lending, Fintech Lending, NBFCs, or Banking/Financial Services.
 



 ·      Hands\-on experience in raising or arranging trade finance, working capital, or alternative debt facilities.
 



 ·      Strong practical knowledge of Invoice Discounting, Factoring, Receivables Financing, Supply Chain Finance, Purchase Order Finance, LC, SBLC, Trade Credit, and other trade\-finance instruments.
 



 ·      Experience dealing directly with international trade\-finance fintechs, NBFCs, private credit funds, institutional lenders, or alternative funding providers.
 



 ·      Existing network or demonstrated ability to build relationships with global trade\-finance fintechs and private credit funds.
 



 ·      Strong financial analysis, negotiation, relationship management, communication, documentation, and execution skills.
 



 ·      Practical understanding of FEMA, RBI regulations, RBI ECB Guidelines, OFAC/sanctions, AML/KYC, UCP 600, and applicable cross\-border financing regulations.
 



 ·      Ability to independently manage funding transactions and deliver actual financing approvals and disbursements.
 



**Preferred Candidate Profile** 




 ·      Candidates who have personally sourced, negotiated, and successfully closed financing transactions will be strongly preferred.
 



 ·      Preference will be given to candidates who can demonstrate experience in:
 



 ·      Securing unsecured/non\-collateralized or collateral\-light funding
 



 ·      Raising trade finance and working\-capital facilities
 



 ·      Building relationships with alternative lenders
 



 ·      Negotiating financing terms
 



 ·      Managing lender due diligence
 



 ·      Closing financing documentation
 



 ·      Obtaining successful fund disbursements
 



 ·      Managing multiple lenders and financing facilities
 



 Candidates with an existing network of trade\-finance companies, fintech lenders, NBFCs, private credit funds, or institutional funding providers will be strongly preferred.

 This role will report into the Global Demand Insights Manager, within Amgen’s Capability Center with a focus on integrating global product\-level forecasts, sales and marketing data with regional and country perspectives to identify trends and support country engagement leads in scenario planning to drive alignment between commercial expectations, supply strategies, and the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process.

* Support integration of advanced analytics and statistical forecasting tools into the end\-to\-end demand planning process.


**Continuous Improvement**

* Support implementation of advanced analytics, visualization, and forecasting tools.
* Contribute to the evolution of demand insight methodologies and best practices.
* Share knowledge and support capability development across the broader forecasting community.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

This role requires strong stakeholder management, excellent written and verbal communication, disciplined requirement tracking, and a techno functional mindset to support analytics products through delivery, go live, and post production support.
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad
   

  

 Shift Timings: 11AM to 8pm
   

  

 Key job responsibilities:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, Management Information Systems, or a related field.
* Equivalent hands on experience in business analysis, product analysis, analytics delivery, reporting, or data driven technology programs will also be considered.

* Contribute to Agile delivery practices by maintaining backlogs, supporting prioritization, clarifying requirements during development, validating delivered functionality, and ensuring acceptance criteria are met.
* Promote strong documentation, data quality, secure delivery, and software development lifecycle practices across analytics initiatives.
* Strong experience in end to end business analysis, including requirement elicitation, analysis, documentation, validation, prioritization, traceability, and change management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with multiple business stakeholders, product owners, developers, QA teams, data engineers, and support teams.
* Ability to understand business terminology, client specific processes, operational workflows, KPIs, and reporting needs, and translate them into clear requirements for technical teams.
* Strong documentation skills, including experience preparing business requirement documents, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, data mapping documentation, meeting notes, decision logs, and support documentation.
* Ability to manage and track multiple requirements, enhancements, defects, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder follow ups across parallel projects or releases.
* Experience supporting reporting, dashboarding, analytics, data, or enterprise application projects in Agile or hybrid delivery models.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts, with the ability to understand data structures, joins, filters, business rules, data validation, and reconciliation logic.
* Familiarity with analytics and reporting tools such as QlikView, Qlik Sense, SSRS, Bold Reports, Tableau, or Power BI, including the ability to discuss dashboard/reporting requirements with business and technical teams.

* Understanding of data quality, data governance, access/security considerations, Agile delivery practices, and secure software development lifecycle concepts.
* Hands on or working exposure to QlikView, Qlik Sense, SSRS, Bold Reports, Tableau, Power BI, or similar enterprise reporting and dashboarding platforms.
* Knowledge of Python for data analysis, automation, validation, or analytics support activities.
* Familiarity with AWS cloud services and data platforms such as S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, RDS, and related analytics or integration services.
* Exposure to lakehouse and modern data platforms such as Databricks, enterprise data warehouses, data lakes, or similar cloud native data ecosystems.
* Awareness of messaging or streaming technologies such as Kafka and their role in data integration or event driven architectures.
* Understanding of API concepts, ETL/ELT processes, data lineage, metadata management, and dashboard/report performance considerations.

title: Vice President, Chief Product Office (CPO) - Business Management
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
**Shift timings: 5\.30 pm \- 3\.30 am IST (applicable for India)**
 The Vice President, CPO Business Management plays a critical role in the day‑to‑day business management, operational reporting, and strategic communication of the Product organization. This role sits at the intersection of content, business management, and execution, supporting the Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) for the CPO.
   

  

 The role is responsible for driving operational rigor and transparency across the CPO through business management reporting, headcount and capacity tracking, risk and control support, OKRs, operating model documentation, and monthly business review (MBR) commentary, while continuing to own and govern Product content and narrative.
   

  

 The individual will bring strong execution discipline, analytical insight, and structured thinking to help Product leadership navigate complex priorities, trade‑offs, and operating challenges with clarity and pace.
   

  

 This role partners closely with the Product CAO and Product leadership to ensure that Product strategy, performance, and risks are clearly articulated, consistently governed, and effectively communicated.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong strategic judgment, executive communication expertise, and operational discipline, with the ability to lead content at scale in a complex, fast‑paced environment.
   

  

**Why This Role Is Important To Us**
 As Product continues to scale in size, complexity, and strategic importance, there is a growing need for strong business management capabilities alongside content and narrative leadership.
   

  

**This Role Ensures That**
* Product leadership has clear, reliable insights into performance, capacity, risks, and priorities
* Strategic decisions are supported by consistent reporting and analysis
* Product operates with discipline, transparency, and accountability
* Messaging to senior stakeholders reflects both strategy and operational reality


 This position is foundational to sustaining operational excellence and execution maturity across the Product organization.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
**Product Business Management \& Reporting**
* Own and facilitate business management reporting for the Product organization, including dashboards, scorecards, and executive‑level summaries
* Produce monthly business review (MBR) materials and commentary, translating data into clear insights, risks, and actions for leadership
* Support OKR definition, tracking, and reporting, ensuring alignment between strategy, execution, and outcomes
* Develop and maintain operating model documentation, including roles, responsibilities, governance forums, and decision rights


**Headcount, Capacity \& Resource Management**
* Partner with Finance, HR, and the Product CAO to support:
+ Headcount tracking and reporting
+ Capacity and utilization analysis
+ Workforce planning inputs and hiring approvals

* Maintain transparent views into resource allocation and constraints across Product


**Product related Strategic Narrative and data gathering**
* Review Product content and narrative, ensuring clarity, consistency, and alignment with strategic and operational priorities. Write commentaries, where necessary.
* Translate Product strategy, performance, and risks into clear, compelling executive‑level commentaries
* Coordinate across teams for content creation for senior forums, leadership updates, and cross‑functional communications
* Act as a liaison between the Product Office and partner teams to ensure messaging accuracy and consistency


**Employee Engagement, Talent \& Culture Enablement**
* Partner with the Talent, Learning \& Culture (TLC) Council and related workstreams to support employee engagement, learning, and culture initiatives within the Product organization.
* Coordinate Product participation in enterprise and BU‑level engagement programs, ensuring alignment with Product priorities and capacity.
* Track and report on engagement‑related metrics, actions, and outcomes, including follow‑through on survey results, action plans, and leadership commitments.
* Support leadership with materials, reporting, and updates for TLC Council forums, engagement reviews, and related governance meetings.
* Write commentaries for quarterly internal newsletters and internal social media posts


**Risk, Controls \& Governance Support**
* Support Product leadership in risk identification, issue tracking, and control remediation, including coordination with Operational Risk, Compliance, and Audit
* Assist with documentation and tracking of control actions, governance decisions, and remediation plans
* Help embed consistent governance and operating discipline across Product initiatives


**Execution \& Cross‑Functional Coordination**
* Manage and support strategic, tactical, and ad‑hoc initiatives on behalf of Product leadership
* Act as a trusted partner to the Product CAO helping drive follow‑through on commitments, decisions, and action items
* Coordinate with Marketing, Sales Support, Finance, HR, Risk, and other CAO functions to ensure aligned execution


**Operational Excellence \& Enablement**
* Drive continuous improvement in business management processes, leveraging tools, templates, and automation where appropriate
* Leverage AI tools (including Copilot) to improve reporting efficiency, insight generation, and content quality
* Mentor junior team members and help build a strong bench of business management and content talent
* Support ad hoc strategic initiatives and projects as needed


**What We Value**
 These skills will help you succeed in this role
   

  

* Demonstrated experience in business management, CAO, chief of staff, or strategy support roles
* Strong ability to translate data into executive‑ready insights and narratives
* Experience with headcount, financial, and workforce data, and comfort working across Finance and HR partners
* Proven ability to operate in a matrixed, fast‑paced, and highly regulated environment
* Strong execution rigor with an ability to manage ambiguity and competing priorities
* Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills; familiarity with AI‑enabled productivity tools (e.g., Copilot)
* High emotional intelligence, sound business judgment, and discretion when supporting senior leaders
* Ability to act as a trusted advisor, balancing challenge with partnership


**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**
* Overall, 15\+ years of work experience.
* 8\+ years of relevant business/product experience; prior experience in CAO, business management, strategy, consulting, or transformation roles strongly preferred
* Experience supporting senior leaders within Product, Investment Services, or adjacent financial services functions a plus
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint


**Minimum Salary**
 zł282,000 Annual
   

  

 The minimum salary quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate ultimately works outside of this primary location, the applicable minimum salary may differ.
   

  

 Salary will be determined based on factors such as the position, type of work performed, individual skills, job description, working hours, diligence, initiative, self\-management, length of employment, availability, and the quantity and quality of work delivered, as well as other objective and non\-discriminatory criteria relevant to State Street employees.

**We Offer**
* Permanent contract from day one
* Additional holidays (Birthday Day Off, 3rd and 5th year anniversary Day Off)

* Premium life insurance package and private pension plan
* Wide range of soft skills training, technical workshops, language classes and development programs

* Variety of well\-being programs

title: Finance & Commercial Operations Lead
description:
**Role: Finance \& Commercial Operations Lead** 




**Experience: 7\+ years** 




  





 Fission Labs is a global technology services company specializing in Product Engineering, Cloud, and AI/ML. We partner with high\-growth startups and Fortune 500 enterprises to build scalable, business\-critical technology solutions. We are also the parent company of Cloud Peritus, a Salesforce\-focused consulting firm that helps organizations engineer business transformations through tailored Salesforce solutions across industries like financial services, technology, healthcare, and education. Cloud Peritus's services span advisory, implementation, integrated support, and quality assurance, delivering measurable business impact and operational efficiency for clients through ongoing, long\-term partnerships. Together, our engineering\-first culture empowers teams to solve complex challenges using cutting\-edge technologies while maintaining the highest standards of quality and innovation.
 



  





**What are we looking for!** 




 We are looking for an experienced Finance \& Commercial Operations Lead with 7\+ years of hands\-on expertise to manage end\-to\-end commercial operations, contract management, project tracking, and financial workflows. In this role, you will act as a crucial bridge between Finance, Legal, and Project Delivery teams, owning client contracts, monitoring project delivery milestones, eliminating revenue leakage, driving timely invoicing, and supporting core accounting and financial governance functions.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Commercial Contract \& SoW Management** 



* Contract Drafting \& Review: Draft, evaluate, and finalize Statements of Work (SoWs), Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Non\-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), and Change Requests (CRs) in alignment with legal and commercial guidelines.
* Commercial Terms Alignment: Ensure payment terms, milestone structures, billing schedules, and liability clauses are clearly defined before execution.
* Contract Repository \& Lifecycle: Maintain an organized central repository of all active client agreements, renewals, and expiration dates.



**Milestone Tracking \& Revenue Leakage Control** 



* Work \& Milestone Monitoring: Track ongoing project progress against SoW timelines, deliverables, and billing schedules.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Issue proactive reminders and follow\-ups to Project Leads, Engineering Managers, and Account Managers to obtain timely sign\-offs on completed milestones.
* Change Order / Scope Creep Management: Identify out\-of\-scope work requested by clients and collaborate with project leads to issue Change Requests (CRs) so additional effort is appropriately billed.



**Billing, Invoicing \& Collections** 



* End\-to\-End Invoicing: Prepare and dispatch accurate client invoices based on project models including Time \& Material, Fixed\-Price, Retainers, or Milestone\-based engagements.
* Accounts Receivable (AR) \& Collections: Track payment receipts, follow up on overdue client balances, resolve billing disputes, and optimize overall cash flow.
* Client Onboarding: Conduct financial vetting/credit checks for new clients and set up billing accounts in corporate systems.



**Financial Analysis \& Profitability** 



* Project Profitability Tracking: Analyze real\-time project margins by comparing actual resource costs against target revenue to ensure projects deliver target profitability.
* Revenue Recognition: Ensure revenue is recognized accurately in accordance with accounting standards based on project completion percentages or milestone sign\-offs.



**General Finance \& Operational Support** 



* General Ledger \& Reconciliation: Assist in monthly/quarterly financial closures, revenue reconciliations, and bank/vendor account balancing.
* Process Improvement: Standardize financial workflows, SoW templates, and cross\-functional handoffs between delivery and finance.
* Audit \& Compliance Support: Prepare documentation and schedules for internal and external financial audits.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or professional certifications (CA / CMA / MBA Finance preferred).
* Experience: Minimum 7\+ years of progressive experience in finance operations, commercial management, or revenue operations—ideally within IT services, consulting, or professional services environments.
* Strong financial expertise in revenue recognition, AR tracking, budgeting, project margin analysis, and basic GAAP/IFRS principles.
* Deep understanding of SoW clauses, SLA terms, liability bounds, and billing milestone structures.
* Proficiency in LLM tools, Advanced MS Excel, and finance/accounting platforms such as Zoho or QuickBooks.
* Strong negotiation, assertive follow\-up capabilities, cross\-functional collaboration, and executive reporting skills.
* Experience using AI tools in the Finance domain is preferred.



  





**You would enjoy** 



* Opportunity to work on impactful business and commercial challenges with global reach.
* Vast opportunities for self\-development, including online university access and knowledge sharing opportunities.
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons to foster innovation and learning.
* Generous benefits packages including health insurance, retirement benefits, flexible work hours, and more.
* Supportive work environment with forums to explore passions beyond work.

title: Finance Manager II - Payroll Payments & Audits, Payroll
description:
**Description**
 Finance Manager II – Global Payroll Payments \| APAC \& North America
   

  

 Make Payroll Payments Work at Global Scale
   

  

 How do you ensure that millions of employees across multiple countries are paid accurately, securely, and on time?
   

  

 Join Amazon's Global Payroll Payments team as a Finance Manager II, where you will lead the critical payment layer that connects payroll operations, banking partners, technology teams, and financial controls across APAC and North America.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact leadership role at the intersection of Finance, Payments, Banking, Technology, Risk, and Operations. You will own the end\-to\-end payroll payment lifecycle across multiple markets, lead a team responsible for critical payment controls and audits, manage strategic relationships with banking partners, and drive the modernization of payment infrastructure.
   

  

 You will also play a key role in enabling new country and entity launches, adopting modern payment standards such as ISO 20022 and API\-based integrations, strengthening controls, and using automation and AI\-enabled solutions to simplify and scale payment operations.
   

  

 If you enjoy solving complex problems, operating at scale, building high\-performing teams, and transforming finance processes through technology, this role offers an opportunity to make a direct impact on the employee payment experience across multiple geographies.
   

  

 Why This Role Stands Out
   

  

 Global ownership: Lead payroll payment operations across APAC and North America.
   

  

 High\-impact infrastructure: Influence payment mechanisms that support employee payroll at significant scale.
   

  

 Banking exposure: Build strategic relationships with major banking partners and payment service providers.
   

  

 Transformation mandate: Drive automation, API\-based integrations, ISO 20022 adoption, and process modernization.
   

  

 Leadership opportunity: Develop a team responsible for critical audits, controls, reconciliations, and payment operations.
   

  

 New market launches: Lead payment infrastructure readiness for new entities and geographic expansions.
   

  

 Cross\-functional influence: Partner with Finance, Payroll, Treasury, Technology, Compliance, Risk, and external banking partners.
   

  

 Problem\-solving at scale: Own complex payment incidents and build mechanisms that prevent recurring failures.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Global Payroll Payments team sits at the intersection of Payroll, Finance, Banking, Technology, and Operations.
   

  

 We are responsible for ensuring that payroll payments move securely, accurately, and reliably from payroll processing through banking networks to employees across multiple countries.
   

  

 Our work spans payment operations, banking relationships, financial controls, compliance, payment infrastructure, automation, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Because payroll is a critical employee experience, the team's work requires a strong combination of operational discipline, financial ownership, technology awareness, and customer obsession.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related field.
   

  

 Experience leading finance, payments, banking operations, payroll, controllership, or related financial operations teams.
   

  

 Experience managing and developing people.
   

  

 Experience working with banking partners, payment service providers, financial institutions, or payment technology teams.
   

  

 Experience managing operational controls, audits, reconciliations, risk, or compliance mechanisms.
   

  

 Experience using data and metrics to identify operational issues and drive process improvements.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Experience working across multiple teams, geographies, or business functions.
   

  

 Experience with payroll payments, payment operations, treasury, banking infrastructure, or financial technology.
   

  

 Experience managing payment infrastructure or banking setup for new countries, entities, or business launches.
   

  

 Knowledge of ISO 20022, payment file formats, APIs, banking connectivity, or payment modernization.
   

  

 Experience driving automation, digital transformation, or AI\-enabled process improvements.
   

  

 Experience managing relationships with global banking partners and third\-party service providers.
   

  

 Experience operating in complex, highly regulated, or multi\-country environments.
   

  

 Strong analytical, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and written and verbal communication skills.
   

  

 Experience leading large\-scale operational transformation initiatives.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

**In This Role, Success Means**
 Reliable payments. Strong controls. Scalable infrastructure. Fewer recurring defects. Better automation. Strong banking partnerships. And a team that can operate confidently at global scale.
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to shape how payroll payments evolve across multiple markets while building mechanisms that make the experience more reliable for the employees who depend on them.
   

  

 If you are a finance leader who enjoys solving complex payment problems, working with banks and technology teams, and building scalable operations, we would love to hear from you.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Key Job Responsibilities
   

  

 Lead Global Payroll Payment Operations
   

  

 Own the end\-to\-end payroll payment lifecycle across APAC and North America, including payment file generation, bank submission, transaction monitoring, exception management, and reconciliation.
   

  

 Establish operational mechanisms to monitor payment health, service levels, control performance, and critical payment risks.
   

  

 Review operational dashboards and metrics to identify emerging issues, prioritize actions, and maintain high standards of payment accuracy and timeliness.
   

  

 Lead resolution of payment batch failures, rejected transactions, bank exceptions, and other payment\-related issues.
   

  

 Build and Develop High\-Performing Teams
   

  

 Lead and develop a team responsible for payroll payment audits, banking controls, reconciliations, operational monitoring, and issue resolution.
   

  

 Establish clear goals, performance mechanisms, operating rhythms, and development plans for the team.
   

  

 Create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, data\-driven decision\-making, and operational excellence.
   

  

 Build strong technical and business capabilities within the team to support increasingly complex global payment operations.
   

  

 Drive Banking \& Payment Partnerships
   

  

 Build and manage strategic relationships with banking institutions, payment service providers, third\-party vendors, and internal technology teams.
   

  

 Partner with banks to manage service levels, payment requirements, file specifications, format changes, connectivity, and issue resolution.
   

  

 Coordinate payment format migrations and changes while ensuring business continuity and operational readiness.
   

  

 Represent Amazon's payroll payment requirements in discussions with external banking and technology partners.
   

  

 Enable New Market \& Entity Launches
   

  

 Lead payment infrastructure readiness for new Amazon entities, countries, and market expansions.
   

  

 Coordinate bank account onboarding, payment file specifications, connectivity requirements, testing, user acceptance testing, and go\-live readiness.
   

  

 Partner with Payroll, Treasury, Finance, Technology, Compliance, and other stakeholders to identify dependencies and manage launch risks.
   

  

 Establish scalable mechanisms that enable new markets to onboard efficiently while maintaining strong financial controls.
   

  

 Strengthen Controls, Audit \& Compliance
   

  

 Own mechanisms supporting audit readiness across multiple markets and regulatory environments.
   

  

 Lead reviews of banking audits, account changes, payment controls, reconciliations, and operational exceptions.
   

  

 Analyze audit findings and recurring defects to identify root causes and drive permanent corrective actions.
   

  

 Eliminate redundant or manual audit activities by addressing issues upstream and strengthening preventive controls.
   

  

 Maintain appropriate documentation, evidence, and control mechanisms to support internal and external audit requirements.
   

  

 Drive Automation \& Payment Modernization
   

  

 Identify opportunities to eliminate manual activities and improve the scalability, accuracy, and efficiency of payment operations.

**Job Title – Senior Financial Analyst**
**About The Role**
 The employee will be responsible for managing end to end cash, banking, and related financial operations, ensuring strong governance, accuracy, and compliance across all processes. This role requires a high level of attention to detail, process excellence, and effective collaboration with cross functional teams.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Develop, document, and implement policies, processes, and internal controls related to cash management, banking, and Accounts Payable/Accounts Receivable.
* Manage daily banking operations, including cash/bank reconciliations, expense allocation, and revenue allocation.
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with Payments, Banking, Treasury, Service Desk, OTC, Project teams, and other internal stakeholders.
* Perform reconciliation of revenue and expenses across systems, bank statements, and the general ledger.
* Ensure full compliance with SOX requirements, loss prevention practices, and always maintain audit readiness.
* Minimize unreconciled items and ensure aged open items from bank reconciliations are addressed promptly.
* Process, review, and approve journals and requests with 100% accuracy and in accordance with Best in Class (BIC) standards.
* Involve in Balance Sheet reconciliation preparations and reviews and ensure account reconciliations are prepared and completed with 100% accuracy and high\-quality standards.
* Execute month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end closing activities, demonstrating a commitment to exceptional delivery.
* Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliations and complete related reporting activities adhering to BIC standards.
* Manage Pay in Full (PIF) requests and payment voiding activities as required.
* Identify, propose, and implement process enhancements, best practices, and automation opportunities to improve productivity and output quality.


**What You'll Need**
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting; professional certifications are an added advantage.
* Experience in managing multi site cash and banking operations with diverse income streams.
* Strong reconciliation capabilities with excellent attention to detail.
* Proficiency in English, including strong verbal and business writing skills.
* Effective communication skills with the ability to interact confidently with management across Finance and Business teams.
* Experience working in a large global organisation and within a matrix structure.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Solid understanding of finance systems and technical integrations; experience with SAP, AX Dynamics, i\-Scala \& PeopleSoft/MyFinance is an advantage.
* Willingness to work from the office during the KT and Stabilization phase, followed by hybrid work as per management direction.
* Commitment to going the extra mile to achieve high\-quality outcomes.
* Flexibility and adaptability to support management with process improvement, AI, and finance transformation initiatives.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively.

* Health Care: Health Insurance to Self, Immediate family \& Parents/In\-laws
* Accident \& Term life Insurance for all employees Accident \& Term life Insurance for all employees.
* Food \& Snacks: Free Meals \& snacks are provided in all shifts.

* Child Care: We partner with Klay day care and CBRE employees get 100% waiver on admission fee. This Day school is in our HYD campus.
* Entertainment: On floor \- Chess, Carrom board, Table tennis, Foosball.


**Our Values In Hiring**
 At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong.
   

  

 We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.
   

  

**CBRE Business Services Organisation (BSO) is a part of CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE:CBRE):**
 CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE:CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S\&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm (based on 2023 revenue). The company has more than 130,000 employees (including Turner \& Townsend employees) serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves a diverse range of clients with an integrated suite of services, including facilities, transaction, and project management; property management; investment management; appraisal and valuation; property leasing; strategic consulting; property sales; mortgage services and development services. Please visit our website at www.cbre.com. We routinely post important information on our website, including corporate and investor presentations and financial information. We intend to use our website as a means of disclosing material, non\-public information and for complying with our disclosure obligations under Regulation FD. Such disclosures will be included in the Investor Relations section of our website at https://ir.cbre.com. * Cost Optimization: Identifies opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvements to enhance the overall financial performance of sales operations.
* Collaborative Approach: Works closely with sales teams, finance departments, and other stakeholders to align financial goals with sales objectives and drive business success.

* Strong analytical and logical skills.
* Manages a large team that would typically consist of both experienced professionals and managers.
* Ability to manage large volumes of data and simplify it through the preparation of actionable dashboards.
* Ability to manage several projects or tasks and complete them in a timely manner.
* Ability to independently navigate ambiguous situations and deliver tangible impact for the business.
* Exercises considerable latitude in determining deliverables of assignments, with limited oversight from the manager.
* Communicates with internal and external customers concerning ongoing operations, programs, or processes.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**
* Chartered Accountant (CA) or full\-time MBA from a reputed institution, with 12–16 years of progressive experience in finance, financial planning and analysis (FP\&A), accounting, or business finance within a multinational organization.
* Experience leading financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and management reporting processes.
* Experience partnering with senior business leaders to support strategic decision\-making and business performance management.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling and analysis of large and complex datasets.
* Experience developing and maintaining financial reporting, forecasting, and performance measurement frameworks. Preferred Qualifications
* Experience within the healthcare, medical technology, pharmaceutical, or life sciences industry.
* Experience supporting Research \& Development (R\&D), Quality, or technical functions through finance business partnering activities.

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

 and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Markets Business Finance \& Control (BF\&C) is a division of Global Banking \& Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for the production and independent validation of Global Markets' profit and loss and balance sheet. The team is also responsible for running valuation controls to ensure fair value of balance sheet in accordance with internal valuation methodology and regulatory requirements. This includes independent price verification of both vanilla securities/derivatives and complex/illiquid assets such as exotic derivatives and distressed assets. Additionally, the team also calculates relevant valuation adjustments including adjustments for illiquidity, concentration, model limitations etc. as applicable. The team is also responsible for calculating and reporting prudential valuation adjustments on a quarterly basis.
   

  

 The team works closely with front office, middle office, traders, valuation control and methodology (GVG) teams to drive the control agenda across the business.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 IPV Center of Excellence forms part of the GBAM CFO Group and is a control and business advisory function. The team’s work primarily covers valuation controls for various asset classes across Global Banking and Markets, with a dynamic book of work providing opportunities to centralize, enhance and implement best practices for global valuation routines.
   

  

 We are looking to recruit an individual to work in the valuations control area for one or a group of asset classes within FICC Macro (Rates/FX/Commodities) / FICC Micro (Credit/Mortgages/Munis) / XVA / Equities businesses in Global Markets. The candidate’s main responsibility will be to functionally lead and deliver Independent Price Verification, Valuation Adjustments, Prudent Valuations and Fair Value Hierarchy assessment, providing a high standard of analysis and explanation.
   

  

 The candidate will therefore have considerable interaction with the respective Front Office, Finance and Global Valuations Group (GVG) teams so good communication and time management skills are an essential requirement for this job. The candidate should have extensive experience of functionally leading high performing teams that deliver valuation control capabilities. The candidate will be expected to leverage her/his extensive knowledge of processes and best practices within Finance, operations, risk management and talent management to ensure that the GBS team operates effectively as a key strategic component of the global GBAM Finance organization.
   

  

 The team is also encouraged to take part in employee engagement and diversity and inclusion initiatives to help continue to make Bank of America a great place to work.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Performing the calculation and analysis of valuation controls including IPV, valuation adjustments and prudent valuation adjustments, as well as ownership for Fair Value Hierarchy levelling.
* Demonstrate strong SME knowledge with the ability to operate with end\-to\-end accountability.
* Working with the Global Valuation Group to ensure ongoing review \& enhancement of valuation control methodologies and practices.
* Provide strong technical leadership on independent valuation principles.
* Strong understanding of trader’s risk positions and valuation principles, own the end\-to\-end desk communication and challenge process for GBAM Finance.
* Timely identification and escalation of red flags to Business Finance and Control leads and other independent stakeholders.
* Drive solid supervisory reviews and governance around implementation of the valuation framework.
* Work closely with the trading desks on valuation issues and valuation differences.

description:
Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally.
 



 Our mission: to bring health in people's hands by making self\-care as simple as it should be for over half a billion consumers worldwide.
 



 At the core of this mission is our 100\+ loved brands, our 11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites and four specialized science and innovation development centers.
 



 Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world's most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
 



 B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet.
 



 Find out more about our mission to bring health in your hands at www.opella.com.
 



  





 You've built experience, now use it where bold ideas meet real impact. At Opella, we're challenging how self\-care works for millions of people and need leaders and experts ready to shape what's next. As an SAP Functional Expert – Treasury, you'll bring your skill, your curiosity and your drive to make health simpler, smarter and more human.
 



  





**About the job** 




 The SAP Treasury functional expert role is a pivotal, senior position within the digital business solution team for Opella. Acting as an internal SAP consultant and design authority, you will own the functional integrity of the global Treasury application landscape — from SAP TRM and Polaris deployments through to day\-to\-day run and support — and ensure treasury processes, systems and business requirements stay aligned.
 



  





 This is a role with a long horizon. Beyond deployment and continuous enhancement, you will help shape and deliver Opella's 2027–2030 transformation roadmap as the company moves towards a single global ERP strategy, setting the direction for Treasury within it rather than only executing against it.
 



  





**Main Responsibilities** 




**Business partnership \& governance** 




 \* Act as the senior liaison to global Treasury and Finance stakeholders, working within defined governance frameworks and proactively recommending process and system improvements.
 



 \* Build and maintain a deep understanding of Treasury business processes — cash management, liquidity planning, bank account management, financial risk management, payments and in\-house banking — and assess the application landscape for strengths, gaps and integration opportunities.
 



 \* Provide consultative support on business\-led technology initiatives, ensuring alignment with Digital, Finance and enterprise standards.
 



 \* Challenge constructively: translate business requirements into scalable, sustainable functional designs rather than one\-off fixes.
 



  





  





**Solution design \& technical authority** 




 \* Lead solution design and fit\-gap analysis for SAP TRM and Polaris deployments across the global landscape.
 



 \* Validate and approve solution designs delivered by project teams and external partners, ensuring consistency, compliance, auditability and end\-to\-end financial integration.
 



 \* Provide deep functional and technical expertise across SAP Treasury and Finance modules — TRM, Cash \& Liquidity Management, In\-House Cash, Bank Account Management, Bank Communication Management, Multi\-Bank Connectivity and FSCM.
 



 \* Ensure successful implementation and integration of SAP Treasury modules on S/4HANA, and seamless integration with SAP FI/CO and adjacent financial systems.
 



  





**Transformation \& project delivery** 




 \* Contribute to and drive the 2027–2030 ERP transformation roadmap for Treasury as Opella converges on a single global ERP.
 



 \* Lead or support end\-to\-end delivery of Business Value Projects, from business case creation through implementation and KPI monitoring.
 



 \* Develop and execute comprehensive testing strategies (Unit, SIT, UAT), define test cases and follow through to sign\-off.
 



 \* Oversee data migration and cut\-over planning for go\-live readiness, and steer Hypercare until projects transition cleanly to BAU.
 



 \* Surface issues and risks early, identify the right stakeholders, and keep delivery decisions transparent.
 



  





**Run, support \& continuous improvement** 




 \* Ensure business continuity and effective ways of working with the ERP Support and Platform teams on incident management.
 



 \* Provide ongoing support, troubleshooting and optimization across the Treasury domain (cash, payments, risk, investments, bank interfaces); ensure incidents are resolved within SLA and drive root cause analysis on recurring or critical issues.
 



 \* Partner with Product Owners and Business Owners to prioritize the enhancement backlog, reducing incident volume and improving stability and user experience.
 



 \* Ensure the system is well documented and that documentation stays current.
 



  





**Collaboration, change \& adoption** 




 \* Engage with Architecture, Integration and Data teams so Treasury applications follow best practice in design, integration patterns, security and data management; contribute to the evolution of those enterprise standards.
 



 \* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define master data, analytics, authorizations and UX strategies.
 



 \* Drive change management and training initiatives to ensure smooth adoption of new systems.
 



 \* Act as key liaison with SAP development teams and external partners for incident resolution and co\-innovation.
 



  





**About You** 




**SAP expertise (core requirement)** 




 \* 8\+ years of strong functional experience across SAP Treasury and Finance modules, including:
 



 \* SAP Treasury \& Risk Management (TRM) — Transaction Manager, Market Risk Analyzer, Hedge Management
 



 \* SAP CLM (Cash \& Liquidity Management)
 



 \* SAP IHC (In\-House Cash / in\-house banking)
 



 \* SAP BAM (Bank Account Management)
 



 \* SAP BCM (Bank Communication Management)
 



 \* SAP MBC (Multi\-Bank Connectivity)
 



 \* Proven experience in SAP S/4HANA implementations and international roll\-out of a core model.
 



 \* Skilled in integration with SAP FI/CO and related financial systems.
 



  





**Treasury and delivery experience** 




 \* Proven, end\-to\-end command of corporate treasury processes: cash management, liquidity planning, financial risk management, FX/MM instruments, payments, bank connectivity and in\-house banking.
 



 \* Solid understanding of compliance (IFRS/GAAP), risk management and audit expectations.
 



 \* Track record of managing complex projects, full testing cycles and stakeholder coordination across a global, multi\-landscape environment.
 



 \* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable and sustainable functional designs.
 



 \* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem\-solving skills.
 



  





**Qualifications and languages** 




 \* Degree in Finance, Economics or a related field; project management or treasury certifications are a plus.
 



 \* Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
 



 \* Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a global, multicultural environment.
 



  





**Preferred** 




 \* Experience with integration platforms (SAP CPI, APIs, middleware).
 



 \* Familiarity with Agile ways of working and tooling (Jira, Confluence).
 



 \* Hands\-on experience with incident, problem and change management processes.
 



 \* Exposure to data governance, master data concepts and reporting tools.
 



  





**How you work** 




 \* Strong business acumen and the confidence to challenge constructively.
 



 \* Proactive and solution\-oriented, balancing strategic thinking with operational execution.
 



 \* Able to work independently while fostering collaboration across teams.
 



 \* Continuous improvement mindset with a clear focus on delivering business value.

description:

**About the Company** 




 Mastermindnetwork is the hiring organization for this Vice President \- Finance and Accounting Transformation opportunity. The available company brief does not include additional information about its industry, operating scale, culture, products, customers, milestones, or market position, so no unsupported claims have been added. This role is defined around enterprise finance transformation ownership across Record to Report, Order to Cash, and Procure to Pay. The successful leader will connect finance process redesign, ERP implementation, technology decisions, and measurable business outcomes. The position is based in Delhi or Hyderabad and requires working from the office. Candidates should bring substantial experience leading complex transformation programs, preferably from a consulting background, with mandatory end\-to\-end implementation experience on SAP, Oracle, or another enterprise resource planning platform. FMCG or CPG project experience is mandatory for consideration. The role is intended for an operator who can combine executive stakeholder leadership with practical techno\-functional delivery depth.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Own the finance transformation agenda across R2R, O2C, and P2P, converting business priorities into scalable process, technology, and operating\-model outcomes. Lead end\-to\-end ERP implementation programs across discovery, design, build, testing, deployment, stabilization, and value realization. Act as the senior techno\-functional bridge between finance leaders, business stakeholders, technology teams, system integrators, and executive sponsors. Establish governance, architecture alignment, delivery controls, and benefits tracking across the portfolio. The role requires practical hands\-on understanding rather than advisory\-only exposure, with the ability to challenge designs, resolve complex dependencies, and make implementation decisions. FMCG or CPG project experience is mandatory, while consulting experience is preferred. Success will be measured through adoption, process standardization, controls, reporting quality, cycle\-time improvement, and sustained business value.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the integrated transformation roadmap across R2R, O2C, and P2P, aligning process, data, controls, and ERP decisions with enterprise finance outcomes and measurable value realization.
* Lead end\-to\-end SAP, Oracle, or comparable ERP implementation delivery from requirements and solution design through testing, cutover, stabilization, and post\-go\-live performance improvement.
* Govern system integrators, functional workstreams, and senior stakeholders through structured decision forums, risk controls, dependency management, and transparent executive reporting.
* Translate finance operating\-model requirements into practical techno\-functional solutions, challenging process designs and configuration choices that create standardization, control, scalability, and user adoption.
* Build transformation benefits tracking across close, collections, payables, working capital, compliance, reporting quality, and process cycle times to demonstrate sustained business impact.
* Apply FMCG or CPG project experience to address high\-volume, multi\-entity, customer, supplier, inventory, and commercial finance complexities within transformation programs.
* Lead change adoption across finance and business teams by establishing ownership, capability building, communication, and operating discipline required for new processes and systems.
* Resolve cross\-tower issues decisively, balancing business continuity, implementation timelines, risk exposure, architecture integrity, and long\-term maintainability.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Mandatory hands\-on, end\-to\-end implementation experience with SAP, Oracle, or another enterprise ERP platform, covering design, configuration oversight, testing, deployment, and stabilization.
* Strong techno\-functional command of R2R, O2C, and P2P processes, including controls, master data, integrations, reporting, close, collections, procurement, and payables outcomes.
* Proven transformation governance capability across system integrators, cross\-functional teams, executive stakeholders, delivery risks, dependencies, benefits, and adoption measures.
* Mandatory experience delivering FMCG or CPG\-related transformation projects involving complex, high\-volume, multi\-entity finance and commercial operating environments.
* Strong consulting, problem\-solving, communication, and executive influencing skills, with the ability to convert ambiguity into implementable decisions and measurable outcomes.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience managing global or multi\-country ERP transformation programs with common templates, localization requirements, shared services, and complex integration landscapes.
* Exposure to finance data, analytics, automation, controls, process mining, or adjacent technologies that improve transparency, decision quality, and operational performance.
* Experience leading post\-go\-live optimization, value realization, and continuous improvement beyond initial implementation delivery.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* 15–23 years of experience in finance transformation, ERP delivery, enterprise technology, consulting, or related leadership roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex programs and business outcomes.
* Mandatory end\-to\-end ERP implementation experience on SAP, Oracle, or a comparable platform, combining executive\-level leadership with sufficient hands\-on techno\-functional depth to guide critical design and delivery decisions.
* Mandatory FMCG or CPG project experience, including an understanding of high\-volume transactions, multi\-entity operations, commercial finance interfaces, supply\-chain dependencies, and the control environment required for scalable transformation.
* A consulting background is preferred, particularly experience advising senior finance and business leaders while also driving implementation execution, issue resolution, stakeholder alignment, and measurable value realization.
* B.Tech or another technical educational background, supported by strong understanding of finance processes across R2R, O2C, and P2P.
* An outcome\-led leadership style that creates accountability across internal teams, system integrators, business owners, and technology partners while maintaining delivery momentum and implementation quality.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Own a high\-impact enterprise finance transformation mandate spanning R2R, O2C, and P2P, with direct influence over process, technology, governance, and measurable business outcomes.
* Shape ERP\-led operating\-model change from strategy through implementation and value realization, working at the intersection of finance, technology, and business leadership.
* Bring consulting expertise and FMCG or CPG transformation experience into a senior role where practical delivery judgment and sustained adoption matter as much as strategic vision.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A Vice President\-level mandate with broad ownership of finance transformation across the core R2R, O2C, and P2P towers.
* The opportunity to lead end\-to\-end ERP implementation and measurable operating improvement from either the Delhi or Hyderabad office, with a CTC range of ₹50–75 LPA.
